|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231211064539/https://thedirect.com/article/disney-movies-re-release-abandoned |archive-date=December 11, 2023 |website=The Direct}}</ref>

Following a [[Carriage dispute|carriage agreement]] with [[Spectrum (brand)|Spectrum]] in September 2023, Disney+ became available to Spectrum TV Select subscribers for no extra cost.<ref>{{cite press release |title=The Walt Disney Company and Charter Communications Announce Transformative Agreement for Distribution of Disney's Linear Networks and Direct-To-Consumer Services |date=September 11, 2023 |url=https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/disney-charter-spectrum-agreement/ |access-date=September 11, 2023 |work=[[Walt Disney Company]] |archive-date=September 11, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230911164921/https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/disney-charter-spectrum-agreement/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

The ad-tier version was later launched in Canada and parts of Europe by November 1, 2023.<ref>{{cite web |last=Ramachandran |first=Naman |date=August 10, 2023 |title=Disney+ to Launch Ad-Supported Subscription Plan in Europe in November |url=https://variety.com/2023/tv/global/disney-ad-supported-subscription-plan-europe-1235692883/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230810063628/https://variety.com/2023/tv/global/disney-ad-supported-subscription-plan-europe-1235692883/ |archive-date=August 10, 2023 |access-date=August 12, 2023 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=August 9, 2023 |title=Disney+ To Launch Ad-Supported Subscription Offering In Several Countries Across Europe And In Canada On November 1 |url=https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/disney-to-launch-ad-supported-subscription-offering-in-several-countries-across-europe-and-in-canada-on-november-1/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230810060408/https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/disney-to-launch-ad-supported-subscription-offering-in-several-countries-across-europe-and-in-canada-on-november-1/ |archive-date=August 10, 2023 |access-date=August 12, 2023 |website=The Walt Disney Company |language=en-US}}</ref>

On December 6, 2023, Disney added a Hulu content hub to Disney+ as a beta for U.S. Disney Bundle subscribers, in a similar manner to the Star content hub used internationally.<ref name="HWRP">{{cite magazine |last=Weprin |first=Alex |date=December 6, 2023 |title=Disney+ Launches Hulu Hub in Bid to Boost In-House Bundle |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/digital/hulu-launches-disney-plus-combined-content-tile-1235712649/ |access-date=December 7, 2023 |magazine=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |archive-date=April 3, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240403205327/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/digital/hulu-launches-disney-plus-combined-content-tile-1235712649/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In March 2024, Disney+ debuted an updated teal logo design, which Jess Weatherbed at ''[[The Verge]]'' believed was preparation for the service's integration with Hulu.<ref name="2024TealLogo" /> The new animated logo for the streamer to serve as its [[splash screen]] and to open original series and films was also revealed that same month, with a short orchestral theme composed by [[Ludwig Göransson]]. The interface was also updated to match the new teal color scheme, which was dubbed "Aurora" as an homage to [[Aurora (Sleeping Beauty)|Princess Aurora]] from ''[[Sleeping Beauty (1959 film)|Sleeping Beauty]]'' (1959).<ref name="2024TealLogo">{{cite web |last=Weatherbed |first=Jess |date=March 26, 2024 |title=Disney Plus has a new Hulu-ified logo |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/3/26/24112300/disney-plus-new-logo-hulu-green-teal |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240326155900/https://www.theverge.com/2024/3/26/24112300/disney-plus-new-logo-hulu-green-teal |archive-date=March 26, 2024 |access-date=March 26, 2024 |website=[[The Verge]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=March 27, 2024 |title=Hulu on Disney+ Launches in the U.S. for Disney Bundle Subscribers |url=https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/hulu-on-disney-launch-streaming/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240327192923/https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/hulu-on-disney-launch-streaming/ |archive-date=March 27, 2024 |website=[[The Walt Disney Company]]}}</ref>

On March 27, 2024, the Hulu content hub officially exited beta.<ref name="The Verge">{{cite web |date=March 27, 2024 |title=The Disney Plus-Hulu merger is way more than a streaming bundle |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/3/27/24112747/disney-plus-hulu-tile-app-streaming |access-date=March 27, 2024 |work=The Verge |archive-date=March 27, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240327130624/https://www.theverge.com/2024/3/27/24112747/disney-plus-hulu-tile-app-streaming |url-status=live}}</ref> On June 26, 2024, content from the separate [[Star+]] service began to be integrated into Disney+ in Latin America, ahead of its discontinuation the following month.<ref name="StarLatAm">{{cite web |url=https://noticiasdatv.uol.com.br/noticia/mercado/disney-anuncia-unificacao-com-star-e-cria-plano-com-anuncios-no-streaming-117415 |title=Disney+ anuncia unificação com Star+ e cria plano com anúncios no streaming |trans-title=Disney+ announces unification with Star+ and creates a plan with ads on the streaming |work=Notícias da TV |language=pt |date=March 28, 2023 |access-date=March 28, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Disney+ y Star+ se convertirán en una única plataforma en 2024 – TVLaint |url=https://www.tvlaint.com/2023/12/disney-y-star-se-convertiran-en-una.html |access-date=December 12, 2023 |website=tvlaint.com |date=December 12, 2023}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Hayes |first=Dade |date=December 20, 2023 |title=As Disney Streaming Streamlining Continues, Star+ To Shutter Next Year In Latin America As Content Shifts Onto Disney+ |url=https://deadline.com/2023/12/disney-plus-streaming-star-latin-america-content-shifts-2024-1235679092/ |access-date=December 21, 2023 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |archive-date=December 21, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231221000742/https://deadline.com/2023/12/disney-plus-streaming-star-latin-america-content-shifts-2024-1235679092/ |url-status=live}}</ref> On July 25, 2024, Disney announced a partnership with [[Warner Bros. Discovery]] to offer Disney+, Hulu and [[HBO Max|Max]] as a bundle in the United States.<ref>{{cite web |last=Weatherbed |first=Jess |date=July 25, 2024 |title=The Disney Plus, Hulu, and Max streaming bundle is now available |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/7/25/24205865/disney-plus-hulu-max-streaming-bundle-price-availability |access-date=August 20, 2024 |website=The Verge |language=en |archive-date=August 20, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240820044444/https://www.theverge.com/2024/7/25/24205865/disney-plus-hulu-max-streaming-bundle-price-availability |url-status=live}}</ref>

After a woman died in a [[Disney Springs]] restaurant, Disney argued that if a user signs up for a Disney+ subscription or a free trial, the user permanently relinquishes their right to a jury trial in any disputes with the company.<ref name="BusinessInsider">{{cite web |last=Edmonds |first=Lauren |title=Disney is arguing in a wrongful-death case that the terms of a Disney+ account extend to its theme parks |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/disney-wrongful-death-lawsuit-theme-park-2024-8 |website=[[Business Insider]] |publisher=[[Axel Springer SE]] |access-date=August 15, 2024 |date=August 15, 2024 |archive-date=August 14, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240814230522/https://www.businessinsider.com/disney-wrongful-death-lawsuit-theme-park-2024-8 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="ArsTechnica">{{cite web |last=Belanger |first=Ashley |title=Disney fighting restaurant death suit with Disney+ terms "absurd," lawyer says |url=https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2024/08/disney-fighting-restaurant-death-suit-with-disney-terms-absurd-lawyer-says/ |website=[[Ars Technica]] |publisher=[[Condé Nast]] |access-date=August 15, 2024 |date=August 14, 2024 |archive-date=August 15, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240815003216/https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2024/08/disney-fighting-restaurant-death-suit-with-disney-terms-absurd-lawyer-says/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On October 22, 2024, following a similar move by Netflix and Spotify, Disney discontinued support for billing Disney+ and Hulu subscriptions via the [[App Store (Apple)|App Store]] on [[iOS]] platforms, citing Apple's revenue sharing rules for in-app purchases.<ref>{{cite web |last=Peters |first=Jay |date=2024-10-21 |title=Disney Plus and Hulu won't let you sign up through Apple anymore |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/10/21/24276226/disney-plus-hulu-sign-up-apple-app-store-anymore |access-date=2025-10-16 |website=The Verge |language=en-US}}</ref>

In August 2025, Disney announced plans to fully merge Hulu into an updated version of the Disney+ platform in 2026, although the two services would remain separate subscriptions. In addition, it was announced that Hulu would replace Star as its general entertainment brand for international markets; the rebranding took effect on October 8, 2025, which was accompanied by an update to the Disney+ user interface with a focus on recommendations and more visual content.<ref>{{cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=2025-10-02 |title=Disney+ Sets Date for Hulu to Replace Star as Its Global Entertainment Brand, Is Adding New Integrated Features Ahead of Hulu App Phaseout |url=https://variety.com/2025/digital/news/disney-plus-hulu-replace-star-global-app-phaseout-1236537103/ |access-date=2025-10-16 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Weprin |first=Alex |date=2025-08-06 |title=Standalone Hulu App to Wind Down, Be Added to Disney+ In 2026 |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/digital/disney-stop-reporting-subscribr-numbers-hulu-disney-plus-1236338393/ |access-date=2025-08-06 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}}</ref> However, in May 2026, Disney announced that there were no plans to shut down the separate Hulu app.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Spangler |first1=Todd |title=Disney Pulls Hulu Even Tighter Into Disney+ but Company Says 'No Current Plans' to Phase Out Hulu App |url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/disney-plus-hulu-unified-app-phase-out-hulu-1236753838/ |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |access-date=May 20, 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260520025503/https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/disney-plus-hulu-unified-app-phase-out-hulu-1236753838/ |archive-date=May 20, 2026 |date=May 19, 2026 |url-status=live}}</ref>

In late March 2026, Disney+ announced plans to launch an advertisement-supported subscription tier for their Australian and New Zealand markets.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lee |first1=Natasha |title=Disney+ lines up up ad tier for Australia and New Zealand as streaming wars shift to scale |url=https://www.mediaweek.com.au/nicole-bence-nova-2026-strategy/ |website=[[Mediaweek (Australia)|Mediaweek]] |access-date=1 April 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260330094554/https://www.mediaweek.com.au/disney-lines-up-ad-tier-for-australia-and-new-zealand-as-streaming-wars-shift-to-scale/ |archive-date=30 March 2026 |date=30 March 2026 |url-status=live}}</ref>

== Content ==
{{Further|List of Disney+ original programming|List of Disney+ original films}}
[[File:Disney+ Original (2024).svg|thumb|Disney+ original logo used since 2024]]

The service is built around content from Disney's main entertainment studios and film and television library, including [[Walt Disney Pictures]], [[Walt Disney Animation Studios]], [[Disneynature]], [[Disneytoon Studios]], [[Pixar]], [[Marvel Studios]], [[Lucasfilm]], [[National Geographic Partners|National Geographic]], [[20th Century Studios]], [[Searchlight Pictures]], [[Touchstone Pictures]], [[20th Century Animation]], the former [[Saban Entertainment]], [[Blue Sky Studios]] and [[Hollywood Pictures]].<ref name="DisneyPlusLineup" /> The service operates alongside [[Hulu]], which Disney gained a controlling stake in following the 21st Century Fox purchase.<ref name="disneyFullControl">{{cite news |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=May 14, 2019 |title=Disney Assumes Full Control of Hulu in Deal With Comcast |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |url=https://variety.com/2019/digital/news/disney-full-control-hulu-comcast-deal-1203214338/ |url-status=live |access-date=May 14, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190514151620/https://variety.com/2019/digital/news/disney-full-control-hulu-comcast-deal-1203214338/ |archive-date=May 14, 2019}}</ref> Bob Iger stated that at launch, Disney+ would focus on family-oriented entertainment (not carrying any content rated [[Motion Picture Association film rating system#R-rated|R]], {{Nowrap|[[NC-17]]}} or {{Nowrap|[[TV-MA]]}}) and that Hulu would continue to host general entertainment;<ref name="DisneyPlusAnnouncement" /><ref>{{cite news |last=Goldman |first=David |date=December 14, 2017 |title=Disney buys 21st Century Fox: Who gets what |work=CNN Money |url=https://money.cnn.com/2017/12/14/media/disney-fox/index.html|url-status=dead |access-date=December 14, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171214130140/http://money.cnn.com/2017/12/14/media/disney-fox/index.html |archive-date=December 14, 2017}}</ref><ref name="dl">{{cite news |last=Fleming |first=Mike Jr. |date=February 8, 2018 |title=Disney Unveils Inaugural Streaming Service Launch Slate To Town; No R-Rated Fare |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |url=https://deadline.com/2018/02/disney-streaming-service-launch-slate-star-wars-marvel-1202281846/ |access-date=April 5, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180226065353/http://deadline.com/2018/02/disney-streaming-service-launch-slate-star-wars-marvel-1202281846/ |archive-date=February 26, 2018}}</ref> Hulu also hosts Disney+ as an add-on service.<ref>{{cite news |last=Topel |first=Fred |date=July 26, 2019 |title=Hulu Will Offer Disney+ as an Add-On – Here's What That Means For Current Subscribers [TCA 2019] |work=/Film |url=https://www.slashfilm.com/hulu-disney-add-on/ |url-status=live |access-date=July 27, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190726220838/https://www.slashfilm.com/hulu-disney-add-on/ |archive-date=July 26, 2019}}</ref> Content intended for mature audiences (R and TV-MA) was later added to the service, including the Disney+ original ''[[The&nbsp;Beatles: Get&nbsp;Back]]'' (2021), which includes a [[content warning]],<ref>{{cite web |last=Sharf |first=Zack |date=November 29, 2021 |title=Peter Jackson Says Disney Wanted to Ban All Curse Words in 'Get Back,' but Beatles Team Refused |url=https://www.indiewire.com/2021/11/paul-mccartney-refused-disney-ban-curse-words-get-back-1234681863/ |access-date=March 1, 2022 |website=IndieWire |archive-date=March 1, 2022 Netflix television series|Marvel series produced for Netflix]], all of which are rated TV-MA. With the addition of the Marvel Netflix series in March 2022, revised parental controls were introduced to the service in the United States to allow the more mature content of the series to be added, similarly to the controls that already exist for other regions that have the [[Star (Disney+)|Star]] content hub.<ref>{{cite web |last=Andreeva |first=Nellie |date=March 1, 2022 |title=Disney+ Expands Into TV-MA Fare As It Adds Marvel's 'Defenders' Franchise & 'Agents Of S.H.I.E.L.D.' From Netflix |url=https://deadline.com/2022/03/disney-plus-tvma-rating-marvel-the-defenders-franchise-jessica-jones-daredevil-luke-cage-agents-of-shield-netflix-1234962137/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220301211328/https://deadline.com/2022/03/disney-plus-tvma-rating-marvel-the-defenders-franchise-jessica-jones-daredevil-luke-cage-agents-of-shield-netflix-1234962137/ |archive-date=March 1, 2022 |access-date=March 1, 2022 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]}}</ref> On December 6, 2023, Disney launched a content hub for Disney+ similar to that of Star, which contains Hulu content for Disney Bundle subscribers in the United States in beta.<ref name="HWRP" />

=== Content library ===

as select titles from [[20th Television]], [[20th Television Animation]], and [[ABC Signature]].<ref name="DisneyPlusLineup">{{cite web |last=Tyler |first=Adrienne |date=September 19, 2019 ''[[Captain Marvel (film)|Captain Marvel]]'', ''[[Dumbo (2019 film)|Dumbo]]'' (2019) and ''[[Avengers: Endgame]]'' became the first theatrically released Disney films to stream exclusively on Disney+ within the pay-cable window.<ref name="nyt" />

It was announced that Disney+ would add the first 30 seasons of ''[[The Simpsons]]'' to the service at launch,{{efn|name=stark}} as the series' new exclusive home,<ref>{{cite web |last=Sarkar |first=Samit |date=April 11, 2019 |title=Every Simpsons episode coming exclusively to Disney Plus |url=https://www.polygon.com/2019/4/11/18307081/disney-plus-simpsons-episodes-exclusive |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200106155239/https://www.polygon.com/2019/4/11/18307081/disney-plus-simpsons-episodes-exclusive |archive-date=January 6, 2020 |access-date=October 13, 2020 |website=[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Otterson |first=Joe |date=April 11, 2019 |title='The Simpsons' to Stream Exclusively on Disney+ |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |url=https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/the-simpsons-streaming-disney-plus-1203187595/ |url-status=live |access-date=April 12, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190412201721/https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/the-simpsons-streaming-disney-plus-1203187595/ |archive-date=April 12, 2019}}</ref> with season 31 being added on October 2, 2020, season 32 being added on September 29, 2021, and season 33 being added on October 5, 2022, in the United States. Season 34 was added to the service on October 11, 2023.<ref>{{cite web |date=October 26, 2023 |title=The Simpsons Season 34 Is Now Streaming on Disney+ |url=https://comicbook.com/anime/news/the-simpsons-season-34-streaming-disney-plus/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231026144858/https://comicbook.com/anime/news/the-simpsons-season-34-streaming-disney-plus/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=October 26, 2023 |access-date=July 3, 2024}}</ref>

Iger said that Disney+ will eventually host the entire Disney film library, including all of the films that are currently in the "[[Disney Vault]]". service.<ref>{{cite web |last=Grater |first=Tom |date=March 11, 2020 |title=Bob Iger Confirms 'Song Of The South' Won't Be Added To Disney+, Even With Disclaimer ''[[Garfield: A Tail of Two Kitties]]''{{--}}had been temporarily removed from the service in the United States.<ref>{{cite web |last=Schmidt |first=JK |date=January 1, 2020 |title=Disney+ Fans Are On November 22, 2021, Disney and [[WarnerMedia]] reached a deal to amend the pre-existing deal HBO had with [[21st Century Fox]] to allow Disney+ or Hulu and [[HBO Max]] to share the streaming rights to half of 20th Century Studios' and Searchlight Pictures' 2022 theatrical slate in the United States during the pay-one window, with ''[[Ron's Gone Wrong]]'' being the first film under the deal, becoming available on both Disney+ and HBO Max on December 15, 2021.<ref name="20thHBO2022">{{cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=November 22, 2021 |title=Disney, WarnerMedia Carve Up Fox Film Slate Streaming Rights Through End of 2022 (EXCLUSIVE) |url=https://variety.com/2021/digital/news/disney-warnermedia-fox-movies-streaming-2022-1235117329/ |website=Variety |access-date=December 15, 2021 |archive-date=May 31, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220531221143/https://variety.com/2021/digital/news/disney-warnermedia-fox-movies-streaming-2022-1235117329/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Disney still has full streaming rights to any 20th Century and Searchlight films produced for Disney+ or Hulu, while the Disney deal with WarnerMedia for streaming 20th Century and Searchlight films on HBO Max ended in 2022, with Disney+ and Hulu assuming the full pay-one rights to films released after 2022.<ref name="20thHBO2022" />

On September 3, 2024, [[ABC News Live]] was added to Disney+ as a continuous playlist, alongside a continuous Disney+ Playtime preschool playlist.<ref>{{cite web |last=Frank |date=2024-08-06 |title=Disney+ to Introduce Continuous Playlists in U.S. Beginning on September 4 |url=https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/disney-streaming-playlists/ |access-date=2024-09-14 |website=The Walt Disney Company |language=en-US |archive-date=September 14, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240914141034/https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/disney-streaming-playlists/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Original scripted content ===
The service's initial original content goal was planned to include four to five original films and five television shows with budgets from $25–100&nbsp;million.<ref name="dl" /> In January 2019, it was reported that Disney would spend up to $500&nbsp;million in original content for the service.<ref name="DisneyPlusStreamingPlans" />{{efn|''[[The Mandalorian]]'' alone was expected to cost about $10&nbsp;million an episode.<ref name="nyt" />}} Original series based on ''Star Wars'' and [[Marvel Entertainment|Marvel]] properties have been or are being produced. Original ''Star Wars'' series include ''[[The Mandalorian]]''<ref>{{cite news |last=Wade |first=Jessie |date=November 13, 2018 |title=The Mandalorian: Star Wars TV Series Casts Pedro Pascal in Lead (TV series)|What If..?]]'', ''[[I Am Groot]]'', ''[[X-Men '97]]'', ''[[Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man]]'', ''[[Eyes of Wakanda]],'' and ''[[Marvel Zombies (TV series)|Marvel Zombies]]''.<ref name="vty">{{cite news |last=Littleton |first=Cynthia |date=April 11, 2019 |title=Marvel 'What If' Animated Show, 'Frozen II' Docu-Series Headed to Disney+ |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |url=https://variety.com/2019/biz/news/marvel-what-if-disney-plus-frozen-2-1203187556/ |url-status=live |access-date=April 12, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190412094519/https://variety.com/2019/biz/news/marvel-what-if-disney-plus-frozen-2-1203187556/ |archive-date=April 12, 2019}}</ref><ref name="Marvel3ShowsTHR">{{cite news |last=Couch |first=Aaron |date=August 23, 2019 |title=Marvel Unveils 3 New Disney+ Shows Including 'She-Hulk' and 'Moon Knight' |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/marvel-confirms-3-new-disney-shows-including-she-hulk-moon-knight-1232742/ |url-status=live |access-date=April 24, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190823234749/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/heat-vision/marvel-confirms-3-new-disney-shows-including-she-hulk-moon-knight-1232742 |archive-date=August 23, 2019}}</ref>

In January 2019, Disney+ ordered ''[[Diary of a Future President]]'' from [[CBS Television Studios]], its first series from an outside production company.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Goldberg |first1=Lesley |last2=Couch |first2=Aaron |date=April 9, 2019 |title=Disney+: A Comprehensive Guide to All Its Programming (So Far) |work=The Hollywood Reporter |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/disney-a-comprehensive-guide-all-programming-far-1200290 |url-status=live |access-date=April 9, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190409173937/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/disney-a-comprehensive-guide-all-programming-far-1200290 |archive-date=April 9, 2019}}</ref>

A [[High Fidelity (TV series)|television series remake]] of the film ''[[High Fidelity (film)|High Fidelity]]'' was initially announced for Disney+, but in April 2019, it was announced that the project had been moved to Hulu, citing concerns from its staff that the positioning of Disney+ as a family-friendly service was at odds with their creative vision for the series.<ref>{{cite news |last=Andreeva |first=Nellie |date=April 9, 2019 |title='High Fidelity' Series Reboot Starring Zoë Kravitz Moves From Disney+ To Hulu |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |url=https://deadline.com/2019/04/high-fidelity-series-reboot-moves-disney-plus-hulu-zoe-kravitz-1202592038/ |url-status=live |access-date=August 13, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190409214205/https://deadline.com/2019/04/high-fidelity-series-reboot-moves-disney-plus-hulu-zoe-kravitz-1202592038/ |archive-date=April 9, 2019}}</ref> ''[[Love, Victor]]'', a spin-off of the film ''[[Love, Simon]]'', was similarly shifted from Disney+ to Hulu in February 2020.<ref>{{cite web |last=Andreeva |first=Nellie |date=February 24, 2020 |title='Love, Simon' Spinoff Series 'Love, Victor' Moves From Disney+ To Hulu, Sets Launch & Opens Season 2 Writers Room |url=https://deadline.com/2020/02/love-simon-spinoff-series-love-victor-moves-from-disney-to-hulu-premiere-date-opens-season-2-writers-room-1202866549/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200421060826/https://deadline.com/2020/02/love-simon-spinoff-series-love-victor-moves-from-disney-to-hulu-premiere-date-opens-season-2-writers-room-1202866549/ |archive-date=April 21, 2020 |access-date=February 25, 2020 |website=Deadline}}</ref>

In August 2019, Iger announced that 20th Century Fox properties such as ''[[Home Sweet Home Alone|Home Alone]]'', ''[[Night at the Museum (franchise)#Films|Night at the Museum]]'', ''[[Diary of a Wimpy Kid (2021 film)|Diary of a Wimpy Kid]]'' and ''[[Cheaper by the Dozen (2022 film)|Cheaper by the Dozen]]'' will be "'reimagined' for 'a new generation'" exclusively for Disney+<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hayes |first1=Dade |last2=Hipes |first2=Patrick |date=August 6, 2019 |title=Disney+ To Revive 'Home Alone', 'Night At The Museum', More As Part Of Fox Reset |url=https://deadline.com/2019/08/disney-plus-home-alone-night-at-the-museum-reboots-fox-1202662998/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190807124324/https://deadline.com/2019/08/disney-plus-home-alone-night-at-the-museum-reboots-fox-1202662998/ |archive-date=August 7, 2019 |access-date=August 11, 2019 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]}}</ref> by [[20th Century Studios#20th Century Family|Fox Family]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Donnelly |first1=Matt |last2=Lang |first2=Brent |date=August 13, 2019 |title=Fox Feels the Pressure From Disney As Film Flops Mount |url=https://variety.com/2019/film/features/fox-disney-earnings-dark-phoenix-stuber-racing-in-the-rain-1203300260/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190813134854/https://variety.com/2019/film/features/fox-disney-earnings-dark-phoenix-stuber-racing-in-the-rain-1203300260/ |archive-date=August 13, 2019 |access-date=August 13, 2019 |work=Variety}}</ref>

Most original episodic content is released weekly, as opposed to all at once<ref>{{cite web |last=Mitovitch |first=Matt Webb |date=August 24, 2019 |title=Disney+ to Release Episodes Weekly: A Welcome Break From Stress-Bingeing? |url=https://www.tvline.com/news/disney-plus-to-release-tv-episodes-weekly-1092112/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190824190936/https://tvline.com/2019/08/24/disney-plus-to-release-tv-episodes-weekly/ |archive-date=August 24, 2019 |access-date=August 24, 2019 |url-status=live |website=[[TVLine]]}}</ref> with the release time initially being 12:01&nbsp;am. PT on Fridays, which lasted from November 15, 2019, to June 25, 2021. With the premiere of ''Loki'', which debuted on June 9, 2021, Disney shifted the release schedule for new original series and new seasons of the respective series to Wednesdays.<ref>{{cite news |last=Clarke |first=Stewart |date=November 12, 2019 |title=Two Episodes of 'The Mandalorian,' Other Originals to Drop This Week as Disney Plus Goes Live |work=Variety |url=https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/disney-plus-launch-the-mandalorian-star-wars-pixar-marvel-1203401768/ |url-status=live |access-date=November 14, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191113204401/https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/disney-plus-launch-the-mandalorian-star-wars-pixar-marvel-1203401768/ |archive-date=November 13, 2019}}</ref><ref name="tvline616">{{cite web |last=Ausiello |first=Michael |date=June 16, 2021 |title=Disney+ Officially Moves Original Series 'Drop Day' From Friday to Wednesday in Wake of ''Loki''{{'}}s Record-Setting Launch |url=https://www.tvline.com/news/disney-plus-release-day-wednesdays-schedule-change-loki-1234683656/ |access-date=June 16, 2021 |website=TVLine |archive-date=June 16, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210616150121/https://tvline.com/2021/06/16/disney-plus-release-day-wednesdays-schedule-change-loki/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On December 25, 2020, ''[[Soul (2020 film)|Soul]]'' became the first feature-length film from Pixar to be released as a Disney+ original. The following two Pixar films, ''[[Luca (2021 film)|Luca]]'' and ''[[Turning Red]]'', were also released as Disney+ originals.<ref name="Deadline1">{{cite web |last=D'Alessandro |first=Anthony |date=March 23, 2021 |title=Disney Shifts 'Black Widow' & 'Cruella' To Day & Date Release In Theaters And Disney+, Jarring Summer Box Office |url=https://deadline.com/2021/03/black-widow-cruella-disney-plus-theaters-day-and-date-release-1234720116/ |access-date=May 9, 2021 |website=Deadline |archive-date=March 23, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210323183840/https://deadline.com/2021/03/black-widow-cruella-disney-plus-theaters-day-and-date-release-1234720116/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

On February 1, 2022, Disney announced that [[Star Original]] [[Korean drama]] series ''[[Snowdrop (South Korean TV series)|Snowdrop]]'' would be released on Disney+ in the U.S. on February 9, 2022, as a Disney+ original; this marks the series becoming the first international content for Disney+ and the first content as both a Disney+ and Star original.

=== Original unscripted content ===
Disney also plans original factual television content for the service, aiming to "find the ethos of Disney in everyday stories, inspiring hope and sparking the curiosity of audiences of all ages." Some of these series will have ties to Disney properties, including behind-the-scenes documentary miniseries focusing on Disney studios (such as one following the production of ''[[Frozen II]]''),<ref name="vty" /> the Disney-themed [[competition]] cooking competition ''Be Our Chef'', ''Cinema Relics'' (a documentary series showcasing iconic costume and props from Disney films), ''[[Marvel's Hero Project]]'' (a series showcasing "inspiring kids [that] have dedicated their lives to selfless acts of bravery and kindness") and ''[[The Imagineering Story]]'' (a [[Leslie Iwerks]]-directed documentary series chronicling the history and work of [[Walt Disney Imagineering]]).<ref name="hwr0">{{cite web |last=Goldberg |first=Lesley |date=April 10, 2019 |title=Disney+ Unveils Robust Unscripted Slate Featuring Pair of Marvel Docuseries |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/disney-unveils-robust-unscripted-slate-featuring-pair-marvel-docuseries-1200876/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190513180147/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/disney-unveils-robust-unscripted-slate-featuring-pair-marvel-docuseries-1200876 |archive-date=May 13, 2019 |access-date=April 24, 2022 |website=The Hollywood Reporter}}</ref><ref name="vty0">{{cite news |last=Thorne |first=Will |date=April 10, 2019 |title=Disney+ Announces Nonfiction Slate, Signs Deal With 'Chef's Table' Producer Supper Club |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |url=https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/disney-non-fiction-slate-supper-club-deal-1203185782/ |url-status=live |access-date=April 29, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190426021055/https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/disney-non-fiction-slate-supper-club-deal-1203185782/ |archive-date=April 26, Disney reached a two-year pact with the documentary studio Supper Club ([[Brian McGinn]], David Gelb and Jason Sterman, producers of Netflix's ''[[Chef's Table]]'') to produce content for the service, including the [[Conservation biology|conservation]]-themed nature documentary series ''Earthkeepers'', and ''[[Marvel's 616]]'', a documentary series chronicling the cultural and societal impact of Marvel's characters. Other factual series include ''[[Encore! (TV series)|Encore!]]'' (a [[Kristen Bell]]-produced series that reunites casts from high school musical productions to reprise their roles) and ''Rogue Trip'' (a travel series featuring [[Bob Woodruff]] and his son Mack) and the reality competition ''Shop Class''.<ref name="hwr0" /><ref name="vty0" />

On April 8, 2022, it was announced that ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' would be moving from [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] to Disney+ in North America, beginning with [[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series) season 31|season 31]]; in 2023. Disney reversed the change and announced that [[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series) season 32|season 32]] would air live in simulcast on both Disney+ and ABC.<ref>{{cite web |last=Rice |first=Lynette |date=April 8, 2022 |title='Dancing With The Stars' Moving To Disney+ In Stunning Move After 16 Years On ABC |url=https://deadline.com/2022/04/dancing-with-the-stars-leaving-abc-disney-plus-season-31-1234996886/ |access-date=April 8, 2022 |website=Deadline|archive-date=May 22, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220522191502/https://deadline.com/2022/04/dancing-with-the-stars-leaving-abc-disney-plus-season-31-1234996886/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Rice |first=Lynette |date=2023-05-02 |title=‘Dancing With The Stars’ Shocker: Popular Show Is Moving Back To ABC From Disney+ |url=https://deadline.com/2023/05/dancing-with-the-stars-moving-back-to-abc-1235353662/ |access-date=2026-10-08 |website=Deadline |language=en-US}}</ref>

On June 26, 2024, with the closedown of the separate [[Star+]] service, [[ESPN Latin America]] began to be integrated into Disney+ in Latin America and the Caribbean.<ref>{{cite web |last=Napoli |first=Walter |date=June 26, 2024 |title=Atención Argentina // desde hoy está disponible el nuevo Disney+ que incorpora el deporte de ESPN y el entretenimiento de Star |url=https://espnpressroom.com/latinamerica/press-releases/2024/06/atencion-argentina-desde-hoy-esta-disponible-el-nuevo-disney-que-incorpora-el-deporte-de-espn-y-el-entretenimiento-de-star/ |access-date=June 27, 2024 |website=ESPN Press Room Latin America South |language=es |archive-date=June 27, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240627184137/https://espnpressroom.com/latinamerica/press-releases/2024/06/atencion-argentina-desde-hoy-esta-disponible-el-nuevo-disney-que-incorpora-el-deporte-de-espn-y-el-entretenimiento-de-star/ |url-status=live }}</ref> In November 2025, it was announced that the NBA games would be available to stream on Disney+ [[Philippines]].<ref name="filipinba">{{cite web |title=Disney+ Scores Multiyear Deal to Stream NBA Games in the Basketball-Mad Philippines |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/disney-multiyear-deal-stream-nba-games-philippines-1236429370/ |last=Brzeski |first=Patrick |date=17 November 2025 |access-date=24 November 2025}}</ref>

In November 2024, it was announced that an ESPN hub would be added to Disney+ in the United States on December 4; the ESPN hub would include sports broadcasts and original series that are made available to Disney+ and Hulu subscribers, as well as integrate content from [[ESPN+]] for users subscribed to that service. The ESPN hub would also integrate with ESPN's then-upcoming [[ESPN (streaming service)|over-the-top service]] upon its launch in August 2025.<ref>{{cite web |last=Welch |first=Chris |date=2024-12-04 |title=ESPN is coming to the Disney Plus app starting today |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/12/4/24312617/espn-disney-plus-now-available-bundle-free-preview |access-date=2025-10-16 |website=The Verge |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite web |last=Hayes |first=Dade |date=August 6, 2025 |title=ESPN Sets Launch Date And Price For Stand-Alone Streaming Service, Adding WWE And Locking Up More NFL |url=https://deadline.com/2025/08/espn-sets-launch-date-price-streaming-wwe-nfl-1236479810/ |access-date=August 6, 2025 |website=Deadline |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Feldman |first=Jacob |date=December 4, 2024 |title=ESPN Preps for Direct-to-consumer launch with Disney+ Integration |url=https://www.sportico.com/business/media/2024/espn-tile-disney-plus-free-stream-app-1234819023/ |access-date=February 12, 2025 |work=Sportico}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Szalai |first=Georg |date=2026-04-07 |title=ESPN Launches in Europe and Asia-Pacific on Disney+ |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/espn-on-disney-europe-asia-pacific-launches-1236557385/ |access-date=2026-10-07 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}}</ref>

The 2025 edition of the [[KeSPA Cup]] ''[[League of Legends]]'' tournament was exclusive to Disney+, initially in just select Asia-Pacific regions.<ref>{{cite web |title=LoL KeSPA Cup Exclusive To Disney+ Opens With International Congress On Dec. 6 |url=https://en.sportschosun.com/sports/2025/11/lol-kespa-cup-exclusive-to-disney-opens-with-127080 |website=SportsChosun |access-date=11 December 2025 |date=19 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260105163604/https://en.sportschosun.com/sports/2025/11/lol-kespa-cup-exclusive-to-disney-opens-with-127080 |archive-date=January 5, 2026 |url-status=dead}}</ref> Prior to the tournament's playoffs, the tournament became available on Disney+ in the United States.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chocat |first1=Clément |title=LoL: KeSPA Cup now available on Disney+ in the US |url=https://www.sheepesports.com/en/articles/lol-kespa-cup-now-available-on-disney-in-the-us/en |access-date=December 21, 2025 |work=Sheep Esports |date=December 11, 2025 |language=en}}</ref>

On April 7, 2026, the ESPN hub launched internationally on Disney+ in 57 markets, predominantly in Europe and the Asia-Pacific, incorporating acquired properties and those to which ESPN holds the global rights.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Szalai |first=Georg |date=2026-04-07 |title=ESPN Launches in Europe and Asia-Pacific on Disney+ |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/espn-on-disney-europe-asia-pacific-launches-1236557385/ |access-date=2026-10-07 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}}</ref> In July and August 2026, Disney+ announced a four-season agreement to televise La Liga in Denmark, Finland, Iceland, and Sweden, and a three-season agreement in France (splitting with [[DAZN]]).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-08-06 |title=Disney+ and DAZN share LaLiga in France |url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2026/08/06/disney-adds-laliga-in-france/ |access-date=2026-10-07 |website=Broadband TV News}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Disney+ expands LaLiga rights across Nordics |url=https://www.advanced-television.com/2026/07/02/disney-expands-laliga-rights-across-nordics/ |access-date=2026-10-07 |website=Advanced Television |language=en-GB}}</ref>

On August 11, 2026, it was announced that Disney had acquired the global streaming rights to [[Formula E]], with the circuit streaming on ESPN+ in the United States and Disney+ internationally. In some territories, this contract is non-exclusive and may co-exist with Formula E's existing television deals (such as its agreement with [[ITV Sport]] in the United Kingdom).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-08-11 |title=Disney+ takes global Formula E rights |url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2026/08/11/disney-takes-global-formula-e-rights/ |access-date=2026-10-07 |website=Broadband TV News}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Littleton |first=Cynthia |date=2026-08-11 |title=Disney+ Grabs Global Rights to Formula E Racing Events |url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/disney-formula-e-racing-global-streaming-rights-1236831859/ |access-date=2026-10-07 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref>

On October 7, 2026, Disney announced that it would simulcast ABC's coverage of [[Super Bowl LXI]] on Disney+ in the United States. To lead towards the broadcast, it was announced that the platform will also simulcast two ''[[Monday Night Football]]'' games, beginning with the October 26, 2026 game; it will mark the first time Disney+ will carry a traditional broadcast of an NFL game in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marangi|first=Catriona|date=2026-10-07|title=Disney+ to stream upcoming Super Bowl|url=https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/07/disney-stream-super-bowl-2027.html|access-date=2026-10-07|website=CNBC|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Spangler|first=Todd|date=October 7, 2026|title=Disney+ Will Stream 2027 Super Bowl|url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/disney-plus-streaming-super-bowl-lxi-2027-1236904265/|website=Variety|access-date=October 7, 2026}}</ref>

=== Simultaneous releases ===

==== Premier Access ====
{{See also|List of Disney+ original films#Premier Access}}
[[File:Disney Plus Premier Access (2020-2021).svg|thumb|Premier Access logo]]

During the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] with movie theaters closed or heavily restricted around the world, Disney took the decision to offer certain movies via the Disney+ platform for an extra fee. Branded "Premier Access", an additional fee was charged over the regular subscription. This allowed unlimited views of the film as long as the customer maintained a Disney+ subscription. The films became available to all subscribers after approximately three months. The additional fee per movie was $29.99 in the US, £19.99 in the UK, and €21.99 in the rest of Europe.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://whatsondisneyplus.com/mulan-disney-premier-access-uk-european-pricing-announced/ |title="Mulan" Disney+ Premier Access UK & European Pricing Announced |website=What's On Disney Plus |date=August 25, 2020}}</ref>

The live-action adaptation of ''[[Mulan (2020 film)|Mulan]]'' was the first to premiere in select countries on Disney+ with Premier Access on September 4, 2020.<ref>{{cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=September 2, 2020 |title='Mulan' Will Be Available to All Disney Plus Subscribers in December for No Extra Cost |access-date=September 2, 2020 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> A second feature film, ''[[Raya and the Last Dragon]]'', was offered through the Premier Access model on March 5, 2021, ==== Network releases ====
In September 2021, it was reported that Disney had begun a new television release strategy by giving episodes from certain series an early premiere on Disney+ ahead of their television debuts. The first series to be released through this strategy was ''[[The Ghost and Molly McGee]]'', with episodes 3 to 5 being released on Disney+ on October 6, 2021.<ref name="DisneyPlusRelease">{{cite web |date=September 22, 2021 |title="The Ghost And Molly McGee" Coming Soon To Disney+ (US) &#124; What's On Disney Plus |url=https://whatsondisneyplus.com/the-ghost-and-molly-mcgee-coming-soon-to-disney-us/ |access-date=September 25, 2021 |archive-date=September 23, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210923201012/https://whatsondisneyplus.com/the-ghost-and-molly-mcgee-coming-soon-to-disney-us/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Walt Disney Television Animation News — Disney+ USA To Debut New Episodes Ahead Of Release... |url=https://disneytvanimation.com/post/663067856386342912/disney-usa-to-debut-new-episodes-ahead-of-release/amp |website=disneytvanimation.com |access-date=September 25, 2021 |archive-date=September 25, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210925110014/https://disneytvanimation.com/post/663067856386342912/disney-usa-to-debut-new-episodes-ahead-of-release/amp |url-status=live}}</ref> This was followed by the third and final season of ''[[Fancy Nancy (TV series)|Fancy Nancy]]'' premiering in its entirety on Disney+ alongside its premiere episode on [[Disney Junior]] on November 12, 2021.<ref>{{cite web |last=Haring |first=Bruce |date=November 8, 2021 |title=Disney+ Day: Full Slate Of New Content Unveiled, Company-Wide Promotions Include Discounted Streaming Subscription |url=https://deadline.com/2021/11/disney-plus-day-full-slate-new-content-shang-chi-jungle-cruise-promotions-discounts-1234869624/ |access-date=December 1, 2021 |archive-date=January 6, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220106154302/https://deadline.com/2021/11/disney-plus-day-full-slate-new-content-shang-chi-jungle-cruise-promotions-discounts-1234869624/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

In November 2021, it was reported that the [[List of Disney Channel original films|Disney Channel Original Movie]], ''[[Christmas...Again?!]]'' would be released on Disney+ on December 3, 2021, the same day of its television premiere, marking the first film to receive a simultaneous release.<ref>{{cite web |title=Next on Disney+: December 2021 |url=https://dmedmedia.disney.com/news/next-on-disney-plus-december-2021 |website=DMED Media |access-date=February 6, 2022 |archive-date=February 6, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220206210802/https://dmedmedia.disney.com/news/next-on-disney-plus-december-2021 |url-status=dead}}</ref> A similar approach would be taken with future Disney Channel Original Movies, becoming available on Disney+ the day following their premieres on Disney Channel with movies like ''[[Prom Pact]]'' and ''[[The Naughty Nine]]''. This ultimately lead to Disney Channel Original Movies being rebranded to "Disney Original Movies".

=== Third-party content ===
In addition to Disney's own content, select television programs produced by third-party companies but broadcast on Disney-owned television channels are also featured, such as Ludo Studio's ''[[Bluey (TV series)|Bluey]]'', supplied though [[BBC Studios]]. Content co-produced with Disney's European subsidiaries, such as Zagtoon's ''[[Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir]]'' and ''[[Ghostforce]],'' [[Hasbro Entertainment]]'s ''[[Kiya & the Kimoja Heroes]]'' and ''[[PJ Masks]]''; [[Banijay Kids & Family]]'s ''[[The Unstoppable Yellow Yeti]]'' and Samka Studios' ''Vikingskool'' are also available on Disney+ in several territories worldwide.<ref name="DisneyPlusLineup" />

In October 2022, Disney+ announced that it had acquired streaming rights, excluding the United Kingdom & Ireland (which remained to be streamed on [[BBC iPlayer]]), to the BBC series ''[[Doctor Who]]'' starting in 2023 with the [[Doctor Who specials (2023)|60th Anniversary Specials]] starring [[David Tennant]] as the [[Fourteenth Doctor]] and [[Catherine Tate]] as [[Donna Noble]], and continuing with its upcoming fourteenth series starring [[Ncuti Gatwa]] as the [[Fifteenth Doctor]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Ritman |first=Alex |date=October 25, 2022 |title='Doctor Who' Heading to Disney+ in Landmark Streaming Deal |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/doctor-who-disneyplus-streaming-1235248110/ |access-date=October 25, 2022 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |archive-date=October 25, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221025135621/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/doctor-who-disneyplus-streaming-1235248110/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On February 7, 2024, Disney+ obtained the streaming rights to the 2023 concert film ''[[Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour]]'', for which they will stream an exclusive unabridged edit of the film dubbed "[[Taylor Swift|Taylor]]'s Version," with songs not featured in the theatrical and VOD releases, beginning March 15.<ref>{{cite web |last=Whitten |first=Sarah |date=February 7, 2024 |title=Taylor Swift Eras Tour film to stream exclusively on Disney+ starting March 15 |url=https://www.cnbc.com/2024/02/07/taylor-swift-eras-tour-film-to-stream-on-disney-in-march.html |access-date=February 7, 2024 |publisher=CNBC |language=en |archive-date=February 7, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240207214446/https://www.cnbc.com/2024/02/07/taylor-swift-eras-tour-film-to-stream-on-disney-in-march.html |url-status=live}}</ref>

As a result of the Hulu acquisition, select titles from [[DreamWorks Animation]] and [[Warner Bros. Discovery]], who have a partial deal with Hulu, have also begun to appear on the service, including the 2004 comedy film ''[[Shark Tale]]'' and the series ''[[The Croods: Family Tree]],'' as well as the [[Cartoon Network]] series ''[[The Amazing World of Gumball]]''<ref name="ComingNovember2023">{{cite web |last=Ridgely |first=Charlie |date=October 26, 2023 |title=Everything Coming to Netflix, Disney+, MAX & Other Major Streaming Services in November 2023 |url=https://comicbook.com/movies/news/new-streaming-november-2023-netflix-disney-plus-max/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231027024524/https://comicbook.com/movies/news/new-streaming-november-2023-netflix-disney-plus-max/ |archive-date=October 27, 2023 |website=Comicbook |language=en}}</ref> and its continuation series, ''[[The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/the-wonderfully-weird-world-of-gumball-release-date-hulu/ |title=The Amazing World of Gumball Reveals Release Date for New Series (& It's Coming Soon) |date=June 17, 2025 |website=ComicBook.com |author=Nick Valdez}}</ref>

In Latin America, Disney+ carries a large number of films and TV series from [[NBCUniversal]] such as ''[[Chucky (TV series)|Chucky]]'' and [[Paramount Global]] as a result of its merger with [[Star+]] which previously carried this content on their platform.

Outside the US, the [[The Twilight Saga (film series)|''Twilight'' films]] were made available to stream on Disney+ under the Star hub including Australia, New Zealand, Canada, United Kingdom, and other regions, supposedly done via a small content deal with [[Lionsgate Studios|Lionsgate]] in May 2024.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://uk.news.yahoo.com/5-twilight-movies-now-available-184400048.html |title=All 5 Twilight movies are now available to watch on Disney+ |date=May 2024}}</ref> They were later removed from the platform in November 2024.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://whatsondisneyplus.com/twilight-saga-removed-from-disney/ |title="Twilight" Saga Removed from Disney+ |date=November 2, 2024}}</ref>

In select regions such as Australia, New Zealand, Germany and more, ''[[The Rookie]]'' is available to stream on Disney+ via the Star content hub. The series was formally produced by [[ABC Signature]] and [[EOne]] and is currently produced by [[20th Television]] and [[Lionsgate Television]], with Disney holding US distribution rights to the series and its spin-offs and Hasbro's EOne, now Lionsgate handling international distribution rights the series and its spin-offs as a result of its acquisition of EOne and merging Entertainment One into Lionsgate Television. This implies that another deal has been done with EOne, now Lionsgate for Disney+.

From the start of 2025, a few [[Warner Bros. Television]] shows began appearing on Disney+ outside the U.S. via the [[Star (Disney+)|Star hub]] including ''[[Gilmore Girls]]'', ''[[The Big Bang Theory]],'' and ''[[Young Sheldon]]'', implying that Warner Bros. has done a content deal with Disney.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.disney.com.au/news/what-to-watch-on-disney-plus-february-2025-watchlist |title=What to watch on Disney+ this month: New content dropping in February}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://whatsondisneyplus.com/disney-adds-the-big-bang-theory-in-the-uk/ |title=Disney+ Adds "The Big Bang Theory" in the UK |date=January 22, 2025}}</ref>

From February 2025, Disney+ began adding a large number of titles to its [[Star (Disney+)|Star Hub]] outside of the US and Latin America from [[Paramount Pictures|Paramount]], including some [[DreamWorks Pictures]] titles owned by Paramount. This includes major titles and franchises, such as the first six ''[[Mission: Impossible (film series)|Mission: Impossible]]'' films, ''[[Mean Girls]]'', ''[[Clueless]]'', ''[[Grease (film)|Grease]],'' and ''[[Grease 2]]'' as well as the first six films from the ''[[Transformers (film series)|Transformers]]'' franchise. Most of these titles were available until July 31, 2025, excluding ''Transformers'' which was added on July 16, and ''[[Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius]]'' which was added on August 1.<ref>{{cite web |last=Zeck |first=Jessica |title=What to watch on Disney+ in June: New content dropping this month | website=Disney Australia |date=2025-05-31 |url=https://www.disney.com.au/news/what-to-watch-on-disney-plus-june-2025-watchlist |access-date=2025-08-16}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/DisneyPlusAU/posts/psa-this-is-the-last-weekend-youll-be-able-to-have-a-mission-impossible-marathon/1048465117407504/ |title=Disney+ |website=Facebook}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Zeck |first=Jessica |title=What to watch on Disney+ in July: New content dropping this month | website=Disney Australia |date=2025-06-30 |url=https://www.disney.com.au/news/what-to-watch-on-disney-plus-july-2025-watchlist |access-date=2025-08-16}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Zeck |first=Jessica |title=What to watch on Disney+ in August: New content dropping this month |website=Disney Australia |date=2025-07-30 |url=https://www.disney.com.au/news/what-to-watch-on-disney-plus-august-2025-watchlist |access-date=2025-08-16}}</ref>

During July 2025, Disney+ added all seasons of [[The Office (American TV series)|''The Office'' US]] from [[Universal Television]] to its [[Star (Disney+)|Star content hub]] outside the US and Latin America.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/DisneyPlusAU/posts/its-happening-everybody-stay-calm-the-office-is-now-streaming-on-disney-in-austr/1043386364582046/|title=It's happening. ==== Multi-year deal with Sony Pictures ====
In April 2021, Disney and [[Sony Pictures]] reached a multi-year deal to let Sony's titles (such as films from the ''[[Spider-Man in film|Spider-Man]]'' and ''[[Jumanji]]'' franchises, individual tiles like ''[[Stuart Little (film)|Stuart Little]]'',<ref name="ComingNovember2023" /> and anime licensed by [[Funimation]]/[[Crunchyroll]] like ''[[Attack on Titan (TV series)|Attack on Titan]]'' and ''[[Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works (TV series)|Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works]]'') stream on [[Hulu]] and Disney+. A significant number of Sony titles began streaming on Hulu starting in June 2021. It includes films from 2022 onwards.<ref>{{cite web |last=Hayes |first=Dade |date=April 21, 2021 |title=Disney & Sony Reach Windows Deal That Can Sling 'Spider-Man' And Other Franchises To Disney+ For United States, titles from Sony Pictures begun to also be added to Disney+ in regions outside of the U.S., as early as June 2022, starting with the majority of the Spider-Man films.<ref>{{cite web month.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.theverge.com/2023/4/20/23691352/disney-plus-spider-man-venom-movies |title=Disney Plus is getting five Spider-Man movies |website=[[The Verge]] |date=April 20, In addition to this, mature Sony content was made available internationally via the Star hub such as ''[[Justified (TV series)|Justified]]'', ''[[Ghost Rider (2007 film)|Ghost Rider]]'', ''[[The Punisher (2004 film)|The Punisher]]'', ''[[The Good Doctor (American TV series)|The Good Doctor]]'', ''[[Schooled (TV series)|Schooled]]'', ''[[Rescue Me (American TV series)|Rescue Me]]'', ''[[Future Man (TV series)|Future Man]]'', ''[[Damages (TV series)|Damages]]'', ''[[Mr. Mercedes (TV series)|Mr. Mercedes]],'' and ''[[For Life (TV series)|For Life]]'', although most of these were removed from the platform eventually.

==== European deals ====
In European territories, Disney+ contains several locally produced content to fulfill certain countries' local content criteria.

In November 2021, Disney announced that [[StudioCanal]]'s ''[[Paddington (film series)|Paddington]]'' films would be released on Disney+ in the United Kingdom and Ireland,<ref>{{cite news |last=Palmer |first=Roger |date=November 18, 2021 |title=Both "Paddington" Films Coming To Disney+ (UK/Ireland) |publisher=What's On Disney Plus |url=https://whatsondisneyplus.com/both-paddington-films-coming-to-disney-uk-ireland/ |url-status=dead |access-date=November 19, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211118185926/https://whatsondisneyplus.com/both-paddington-films-coming-to-disney-uk-ireland/ |archive-date=November 18, 2021}}</ref> with the films also arriving on Germany and France eventually. Several other StudioCanal movies such as ''[[Maya the Bee (film)|Maya the Bee]]'' are also available on the service.<ref>{{cite web |title=Disney+ Spain Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/ChRkRG0KMwQ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230115174554/https://www.instagram.com/p/ChRkRG0KMwQ/ |archive-date=January 15, 2023 |access-date=August 15, 2022}}</ref>{{Primary source inline|date=May 2024}}

Films from [[Pathé]] such as ''[[Asterix and Obelix vs. Caesar]]''<ref>{{cite web |title=Disney+ Germany Instagram |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/ChRxYxJMZQj |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230115174555/https://www.instagram.com/p/ChRxYxJMZQj/ |archive-date=January 15, 2023 |access-date=August 15, 2022}}</ref>{{Primary source inline|date=May 2024}} and ''[[Chicken Run]]'' are also available on Disney+ in select European territories.<ref>{{cite web |title=''Chicken Run'' on Disney+ |url=https://www.disneyplus.com/en-gb/movies/chicken-run/5PcWiPyrGw3q |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220729155743/https://www.disneyplus.com/en-gb/movies/chicken-run/5PcWiPyrGw3q |archive-date=July 29, 2022 |access-date=June 29, 2022}}</ref>{{Better source needed|date=February 2022}}

[[Hasbro Entertainment]]'s ''[[Peppa Pig]]'' is also available on the service in many EMEA regions, first made available in March 2023.<ref>{{cite web |date=March 8, 2023 |title="Peppa Pig" Launches Across EMEA on Disney+ in 19 New Markets |url=https://www.laughingplace.com/w/news/2023/03/08/peppa-pig-launches-across-emea-on-disney-plus-in-19-new-markets/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230309162551/https://www.laughingplace.com/w/news/2023/03/08/peppa-pig-launches-across-emea-on-disney-plus-in-19-new-markets/ |archive-date=March 9, 2023 |access-date=March 12, 2023 |website=LaughingPlace.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

On 10 July 2025, The Walt Disney Company and [[ITV plc]] announced that they would agree to share programming on Disney+ and [[ITVX]], under slots entitled "Taste of ITVX" and "Taste of Disney+". ITV programmes being added to Disney+ would include ''[[Endeavour (TV series)|Endeavour]]'' and ''[[The 1% Club]]'', while Disney programmes being added to ITVX would include ''[[Andor]]'' and ''[[Lilo and Stitch: The Series]]''.<ref>{{cite press release |url=https://www.itv.com/presscentre/media-releases/disney-and-itv-announce-first-its-kind-strategic-relationship |title=Disney and ITV Announce First-of-its-Kind Strategic Relationship |publisher=ITV |date=10 July 2025 |access-date=23 July 2025}}</ref>

==== Brazilian deals ====
Disney+ also has multiple third-party deals with Brazilian TV networks. Both [[Sistema Brasileiro de Televisão|SBT]] and Disney+ broadcast ''[[The Voice Brasil]]'' for the 13th season,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://f5.folha.uol.com.br/colunistas/outro-canal/2025/08/disney-e-sbt-definem-data-de-estreia-no-novo-the-voice-brasil-saiba-quando-sera.shtml |title=Disney e SBT definem data de estreia no novo The Voice Brasil; saiba quando será}}</ref> and the national awards program ''[[Troféu Imprensa]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://tv.sbt.com.br/programas/jornalismo/fofocalizando/noticia/286230-trofeu-imprensa-homenageia-os-75-anos-da-televisao-brasileira-na-56-edicao-com-exibicao-no-sbt-e-disney |title=Troféu Imprensa homenageia os 75 anos da televisão brasileira na 56ª edição, com exibição no SBT e Disney+}}</ref> Disney+ also has a deal with [[Record (TV network)|Record]], where it both broadcasts the Brazilian reality show ''[[:pt:Casa do Patrão|Casa do Patrão]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.meioemensagem.com.br/midia/record-tera-reality-show-dirigido-por-boninho |title=Record terá reality show dirigido por Boninho}}</ref>

== Device support and service features ==
Disney+ is available for streaming via web browsers on [[Windows]], [[macOS]], and [[Linux]], as well as apps on [[iOS]] and [[Apple TV (device)|Apple TV]], [[Android (operating system)|Android]] and [[Android TV]], [[Fire TV]] and [[Fire HD]], [[Chromecast]] and [[ChromeOS]] devices, [[Samsung Smart TVs]], [[LG Electronics|LG webOS]] TVs, [[Vizio SmartCast]] TVs,<ref>{{cite news |last=Chin [[Accessibility]] features include [[closed captioning]], [[audio description]] (also known as described video) and audio navigation assistance.<ref>{{cite web |last=Graham |first=Jefferson |date=August 23, 2019 |title=What to expect from Disney+ streaming service: Yes, it'll include Marvel and Star Wars |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/talkingtech/2019/08/23/disney-plus-plans-take-netflix-quality-over-quantity/2083966001/ |access-date=September 10, 2021 |website=USA Today |archive-date=September 11, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210911003355/https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/talkingtech/2019/08/23/disney-plus-plans-take-netflix-quality-over-quantity/2083966001/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

Disney+ allows seven user profiles per account, with the ability to stream on four devices concurrently and unlimited downloads for offline viewing. Content is able to be streamed in resolutions up to [[4K resolution|4K]] [[Ultra HD]] in [[Dolby Vision]] and [[HDR10]], with [[Dolby Atmos]] sound on supported devices. Legacy content and Disney+ originals are available in multiple languages.<ref>{{cite web |last=Radulovic |first=Petrana |date=August 24, 2019|title=Everything we learned at D23's Disney Plus presentation |url=https://www.polygon.com/2019/8/24/20830613/d23-2019-disney-plus-marvel-she-hulk-wyatt-russell-star-wars-mandalorian-werner-herzog-new-shows |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190824170847/https://www.polygon.com/2019/8/24/20830613/d23-2019-disney-plus-marvel-she-hulk-wyatt-russell-star-wars-mandalorian-werner-herzog-new-shows |archive-date=August 24, 2019 |access-date=August 24, 2019 |website=[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]]}}</ref> As of March 2026, the Disney+ app and website is translated in 21 languages,<ref>{{cite web |title=What languages are available in the Disney+ app? |url=https://help.disneyplus.com/csp?id=csp_article_content&sys_kb_id=d21f1184db8495945ec1eb2ed3961951 |access-date=June 20, 2022 |archive-date=June 14, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220614101019/https://help.disneyplus.com/csp?id=csp_article_content&sys_kb_id=d21f1184db8495945ec1eb2ed3961951 |url-status=live}}</ref> while the service offers subtitles and dubbing in over 40 languages globally.<ref>{{cite web |title=How to change language on Disney+ |url=https://www.disneyplus.com/explore/articles/how-to-change-language-on-disney-plus |publisher=Disney+ |date=March 18, 2026 |quote=With over 40 languages (and counting!) available on many titles, including Disney+ Originals, you can stream your favorite stories without barriers.}}</ref>

In late May 2020, the service added the ability to switch between 4:3 and 16:9 aspect ratios for early ''Simpsons'' episodes,<ref name="AspectRatioFeature" /> after the service received backlash for cropping episodes to 16:9 by default at launch.<ref name="SimpsonsAspectRatio" /> Disney had done this "in order to guarantee visual quality and consistency across all 30 seasons." To accommodate the feature, [[Disney Streaming Services]] "had to reconfigure its content-delivery engine" while ensuring the new feature would not break any existing features such as continue watching, watchlists and auto-playing, as they did not want to treat the 4:3 versions as bonus content. The resulting changes allowed Disney to apply the existing audio, subtitle information, episode artwork and other metadata from the episodes to both aspect ratios regardless of which is chosen by the user. Joe Rice, vice president of media product at Disney Streaming Services, added that these adjustments "opens up a number of exciting opportunities for novel ways of presenting content in the future."<ref name="AspectRatioFeature">{{cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=May 28, 2020 |title=To Deliver 'The Simpsons' in 4:3 Aspect Ratio, Disney Plus Had to Rearchitect Its Content-Delivery System |url=https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/simpsons-4-by-3-aspect-ratio-disney-plus-1234618818/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200529014928/https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/simpsons-4-by-3-aspect-ratio-disney-plus-1234618818/ |archive-date=May 29, 2020 |access-date=May 28, 2020 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref>

In September 2020, the service added the GroupWatch feature which allows up to seven different Disney+ accounts to link up and co-view programming with one another. Viewers are able to react to content with six different emojis, and control playback for the entire group. It is available on web browser, mobile app, smart TVs and connected TV devices in the United States, and later expanded to Europe in 2020.<ref>{{cite web |last=Alexander |first=Julia |date=September 29, 2020 |title=Disney Plus is rolling out GroupWatch feature to all US subscribers |url=https://www.theverge.com/2020/9/29/21492148/disney-plus-groupwatch-friends-family-us-subscribers-scener-netflix |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200929175828/https://www.theverge.com/2020/9/29/21492148/disney-plus-groupwatch-friends-family-us-subscribers-scener-netflix |archive-date=September 29, 2020 |access-date=September 29, 2020 |website=[[The Verge]]}}</ref> The feature was previously tested in Australia, Canada and New Zealand.<ref>{{cite web |last=Radulovic |first=Petrana |date=September 29, 2020 |title=Disney Plus gets a remote group watch feature |url=https://www.polygon.com/disney-plus/2020/9/29/21492307/disney-plus-group-watch-remote-viewing |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200929184747/https://www.polygon.com/disney-plus/2020/9/29/21492307/disney-plus-group-watch-remote-viewing |archive-date=September 29, 2020 |access-date=September 29, 2020 |website=[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]]}}</ref>

In November 2021, Disney and [[IMAX Corporation|IMAX]] announced that 13 films from the Marvel Cinematic Universe would receive IMAX Enhanced versions on Disney+, that feature IMAX's 1.90:1 aspect ratio for scenes shot in or opened up for the format. This feature became available beginning on November 12, 2021, with the IMAX Enhanced versions also adding other features such as [[DTS, Inc.|DTS]] audio at a later point, as well as all IMAX Enhanced titles still retaining other features from the standard widescreen versions, like Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos.<ref name="IMAXEnhanced">{{cite web |last=Byford |first=Sam |date=November 8, 2021 |title=Disney Plus is upgrading Marvel movies to IMAX aspect ratio |url=https://www.theverge.com/2021/11/8/22764957/marvel-disney-plus-imax-expanded-aspect-ratio |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211108184841/https://www.theverge.com/2021/11/8/22764957/marvel-disney-plus-imax-expanded-aspect-ratio |archive-date=November 8, 2021 |access-date=November 8, 2021 |website=[[The Verge]]}}</ref>

Disney+ has offered an app for [[visionOS]] since the [[Apple Vision Pro]]'s launch; it offers [[3D film|3D versions]] of selected films, and themed 360-degree 3D viewing environments such as the [[El Capitan Theatre]], a [[Landspeeder]] on [[Tatooine]] (''Star Wars''), and [[Stark Tower]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=January 16, 2024 |title=Apple Vision Pro Will Feature 150-Plus 3D Movies at Launch, Immersive Originals, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video and More |url=https://variety.com/2024/digital/news/apple-vision-pro-3d-movies-streaming-apps-disney-plus-1235873608/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240116144204/https://variety.com/2024/digital/news/apple-vision-pro-3d-movies-streaming-apps-disney-plus-1235873608/ |archive-date=January 16, 2024 |access-date=January 26, 2024 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Davis |first=Wes |date=January 16, 2024 |title=Apple Vision Pro will launch with 3D movies from Disney Plus |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/1/16/24039960/apple-vision-pro-3d-movies-disney-plus |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240116145909/https://www.theverge.com/2024/1/16/24039960/apple-vision-pro-3d-movies-disney-plus |archive-date=January 16, 2024 |access-date=January 26, 2024 |website=The Verge |language=en}}</ref>
