In other countries, HBO or Max original programs are licensed to [[List of HBO international channels|third-party networks and streaming services]] under long-term deals. In these cases, Max has left it up to individual rightsholders to decide whether to offer its programming on an over-the-top basis. The extent and lengths of the deals vary by country; not all networks that carry HBO programs also carry Max programs, and in some cases individual programs are carried by different services.<ref name="cp-crave">{{cite web |last=Friend |first=David |date=October 30, 2019 |title=Bell Media bolsters Crave's streaming library under new deal with HBO |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/entertainment/bell-hbo-deal-crave-1.5340676 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191030232903/https://www.cbc.ca/news/entertainment/bell-hbo-deal-crave-1.5340676 |archive-date=October 30, 2019 |access-date=October 30, 2019 |website=[[The Canadian Press]] (via [[CBCNews.ca]])}}</ref><ref name="finder-foxtel">{{cite web |last=Stead |first=Chris |date=May 8, 2020 |title=New Foxtel HBO Warner Bros streaming TV deal explained |url=https://www.finder.com.au/foxtel-hbo-warner-australia-deal-explained |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200522052800/https://www.finder.com.au/foxtel-hbo-warner-australia-deal-explained |archive-date=May 22, 2020 |access-date=May 8, 2020 |website=Finder.com.au}}</ref><ref name="var-sky">{{cite web |last=Clarke |first=Stewart |date=October 30, 2019 |title=Sky and HBO Strike New Programming Deal |url=https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/game-of-thrones-sky-hbo-programming-deal-1203388088/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191030102105/https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/game-of-thrones-sky-hbo-programming-deal-1203388088/ |archive-date=October 30, 2019 |access-date=October 30, 2019 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref>

WarnerMedia said in late 2019 that it planned to continue HBO's existing international licensing partnerships for the time being.<ref>{{cite web |last=Szalai |first=Georg |date=October 30, 2019 |title=How HBO Max May Approach Its Global Rollout |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/how-hbo-max-may-approach-global-rollout-1250697 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191030155530/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/how-hbo-max-may-approach-global-rollout-1250697 |archive-date=October 30, 2019 |access-date=November 2, 2019 |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]}}</ref> However, as part of the WarnerMedia further restructuring announced in August 2020, WarnerMedia president [[Jason Kilar]] said HBO Max would be expanding its scope globally.<ref name="thr-restructure-2020" /> Operations chief Andy Forssell indicated later that year that the company ultimately plans to have HBO Max active in 190 countries, but that a timeline for most of the remaining countries had not been decided.<ref name="tbi-websummit-2020" />

Following the merger of WarnerMedia with Discovery, Inc. in April 2022, Warner Bros. Discovery has decided to halt international expansion of HBO Max in favor of waiting to replace the existing service, as well as HBO Go in Asia-Pacific region, with Max, and instead continuing to license its content to other international distributors such as [[Sky Group|Sky Europe]] and [[Foxtel]] in markets where HBO Max isn't available, in an attempt to reach financial stability for the company.<ref name="FoxtelDeal" /> This also included postponing the launch of Max in France and Belgium until the summer 2024, despite there already being plans to launch the service as HBO Max in 2023.<ref name="FrancePostponed" />

Plans for expansion of HBO Max restarted on 2025 in Australia,<ref name="AustraliaLaunch" /> Turkey,<ref name="TurkeyDebut" /> the Post-Soviet states,<ref name="HollywoodReporter" /> and other Asia-Pacific countries, and are expected to continue into 2026, for regions where Sky Europe operates,<ref name="AU+Sky">{{cite web |last=Littleton |first=Cynthia |date=February 23, 2024 |title=Warner Bros. Discovery's Good News Couldn't Obscure the Warning Signs in Q4 Results |url=https://variety.com/2024/tv/news/warner-bros-discovery-zaslav-q4-earnings-warning-1235921220/ |access-date=February 23, 2024 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |language=en-US |archive-date=February 24, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240224031349/https://variety.com/2024/tv/news/warner-bros-discovery-zaslav-q4-earnings-warning-1235921220/ |url-status=live}}</ref> although the service had already continued to expand before then, but in the form of an additional VOD hub for existing pay TV operators in countries like New Zealand, Japan and Greece.<ref name="Stop Press 22 Oct 2024" /><ref name="Unext" /><ref name="Greece2" />

==== Latin America and the Caribbean ====
HBO Max was launched on June 29, 2021, in the 39 territories of Latin America and the Caribbean, where HBO already operated directly its streaming service HBO Go, and premium television channels.<ref>{{cite web |date=February 11, 2021 |title=oficial: HBO Max llegará a México en junio de este año para sustituir a HBO Go |url=https://www.xataka.com.mx/streaming/oficial-hbo-max-llegara-a-mexico-junio-este-ano-para-sustituir-a-hbo-go |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220705203030/https://www.xataka.com.mx/streaming/oficial-hbo-max-llegara-a-mexico-junio-este-ano-para-sustituir-a-hbo-go |archive-date=July 5, 2022 |access-date=July 5, 2022 |website=Xataka.com.mx}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=October 29, 2019 |title=WarnerMedia Confirms Price And Launch Date For HBO Max |url=https://deadline.com/2019/10/hbo-max-pricing-launch-date-1202771551/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220705203028/https://deadline.com/2019/10/hbo-max-pricing-launch-date-1202771551/ |archive-date=July 5, 2022 |access-date=July 5, 2022 |website=Deadline}}</ref> HBO Max in Latin America and the Caribbean was rebranded as Max on February 27, 2024,<ref name="Max LatAm" /> before it reverted again into HBO Max globally on July 9, 2025.

==== Canada ====
HBO Max does not operate in Canada;<ref>{{cite web |last=Townsend |first=Kelly |date=August 5, 2022 |title=HBO Max, Discovery+ merger not planned for Canada |url=https://playbackonline.ca/2022/08/05/hbo-max-discovery-merger-not-planned-for-canada/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220810231355/https://playbackonline.ca/2022/08/05/hbo-max-discovery-merger-not-planned-for-canada/ |archive-date=August 10, 2022 |access-date=January 28, 2023}}</ref> rights to most Max Original programming produced by Warner Bros. or its subsidiaries are held by [[Bell Canada]]'s subsidiary [[Bell Media]],{{efn| By coincidence, Bell Canada was formerly part-owned by WarnerMedia's 2018–2022 parent company [[AT&T]] until 1975; however Bell's relationship with HBO predated AT&T's acquisition of [[WarnerMedia]]. Bell Media and its predecessors also had a separate partnership with [[Discovery, Inc.]] covering [[USA Network (Canadian TV channel)|Discovery Channel Canada]] and related services, dating back to 1995 with the formation of [[CTV Specialty Television|NetStar Communications]], prior to the acquisition that rebranded TimeWarner as WarnerMedia (post-2014 as what were originally the non-broadcast assets of [[Time Inc.]] had been spun off again from the company since the first iteration of TimeWarner which underwent several changes before and as explained, afterwards) during which Max was announced and launched but preceded the history of Bell-Discovery relationship by 5 years given its original formation in 1990.}} which distributes them via its OTT service [[Crave (streaming service)|Crave]], and its English- and French-language pay television services [[Crave (TV network)|Crave]] and [[Super Écran]] (which themselves include access to the OTT version of Crave via [[TV Everywhere]] credentials). The agreement was first announced in 2019, also renewing Crave's existing rights to first-run HBO programming (Bell operates an [[HBO (Canadian TV channel)|HBO channel]] as a multiplex of Crave) and pay-one rights to Warner Bros. Pictures releases. It does not include the rights to series produced for the service by third-party studios.<ref name="cp-2021plans">{{cite web |last=Friend |first=David |date=October 26, 2021 |title=Crave does away with $9.99 basic package, adds mobile-only streaming option instead |url=https://www.piquenewsmagazine.com/national-business/crave-does-away-with-999-basic-package-adds-mobile-only-streaming-option-instead-4553494 |access-date=October 27, 2021 |agency=[[The Canadian Press]]}}</ref><ref name="ms-2021plans">{{cite web |last=Shankar |first=Bradly |date=October 26, 2021 |title=Crave launches $9.99 mobile-only plan that includes most content |url=https://mobilesyrup.com/2021/10/26/crave-mobile-plan-launch/ |access-date=October 27, 2021 |work=MobileSyrup |publisher=[[Blue Ant Media]]}}</ref> The agreement was most recently renewed in 2024 for an unspecified length.<ref>{{cite web |last=Whittock |first=Jesse |date=2024-10-08 |title=Bell Expands Warner Bros Discovery Pact For HBO & Max Content And Ends Legal Action Over Rogers Deal |url=https://deadline.com/2024/10/bell-warner-bros-discovery-hbo-max-deal-expands-1236109976/ |access-date=2024-10-08 |website=Deadline |language=en-US |archive-date=October 8, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241008135501/https://deadline.com/2024/10/bell-warner-bros-discovery-hbo-max-deal-expands-1236109976/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

The Bell agreement has excluded some of HBO Max's youth, family, and animation programming, which have often been picked up by [[Corus Entertainment]] for its specialty channels, such as [[Cartoon Network (Canada)|Cartoon Network]], [[Treehouse TV|Treehouse]], and [[Adult Swim (Canadian TV channel)|Adult Swim]]<ref name="auto">{{cite web |last=Milligan |first=Mercedes |date=2022-06-08 |title=Corus Upfronts Slate More Adult Swim & Kids Toons for Canada |url=https://www.animationmagazine.net/2022/06/corus-upfronts-slate-more-adult-swim-kids-toons-for-canada/ |access-date=2023-02-23 |website=Animation Magazine |language=en-US |archive-date=December 13, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241213081104/https://www.animationmagazine.net/2022/06/corus-upfronts-slate-more-adult-swim-kids-toons-for-canada/ |url-status=live}}</ref> (in conjunction with the company's long-standing output agreement with [[The Cartoon Network, Inc.|Cartoon Network]]).<ref>{{cite web |title=Corus Entertainment's Powerful Specialty Portfolio Announces Lineup of 2019–2020 Orders |url=https://www.newswire.ca/news-releases/corus-entertainment-s-powerful-specialty-portfolio-announces-lineup-of-2019-2020-orders-887531178.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211204020021/https://www.newswire.ca/news-releases/corus-entertainment-s-powerful-specialty-portfolio-announces-lineup-of-2019-2020-orders-887531178.html |archive-date=December 4, 2021 |access-date=December 21, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Milligan |first=Mercedes |date=June 23, 2020 |title=Corus Ent. Bolsters Specialty Portfolios, Including Toons for All Ages |url=https://www.animationmagazine.net/tv/corus-ent-bolsters-specialty-portfolios-including-toons-for-all-ages/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200823031027/https://www.animationmagazine.net/tv/corus-ent-bolsters-specialty-portfolios-including-toons-for-all-ages/ |archive-date=August 23, 2020 |access-date=December 21, 2021}}</ref><ref name="TeletoonFall21">{{cite web |title=Ytv, Teletoon, and Treehouse Deliver Non-Stop Fun This Fall |url=https://www.corusent.com/news/ytv-teletoon-and-treehouse-deliver-non-stop-fun-this-fall-2/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210913222224/https://www.corusent.com/news/ytv-teletoon-and-treehouse-deliver-non-stop-fun-this-fall/ |archive-date=September 13, 2021 |date=September 13, 2021 |access-date=December 21, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Corus acquires three legacy-brand kids series for fall |url=https://kidscreen.com/2022/06/08/corus-acquires-three-legacy-brand-kids-series-for-fall/ |access-date=2025-01-15 |website=Kidscreen.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Kolm |first=Josh |title=Corus rebrands its animation networks, taking Teletoon off linear TV |url=https://mediaincanada.com/2023/02/22/corus-rebrands-its-animation-networks-taking-teletoon-off-linear-tv/ |access-date=2023-02-22 |website=Mediaincanada.com}}</ref> Some part of WBD library which in HBO Max, available in various website in Canada, WBD's series and movies programming in Crave,<ref name="auto1">{{cite web |url=https://www.bellmedia.ca/the-lede/press/bell-media-and-warner-bros-discovery-expand-partnership-in-canada/ |title=Bell Media and Warner Bros. Discovery Expand Partnership in Canada - Bell Media |website=Bellmedia.ca |access-date=June 7, 2026}}</ref> Cartoon Network programming in StackTV<ref name="auto"/> and an independent Discovery+ service with all documentary and lifestyle programmings available on here.

==== Europe ====

===== France =====
On November 13, 2008, [[Orange S.A.|Orange]] launched [[Orange Cinéma Séries]] (renamed OCS in 2012), a five-channel package, dedicated to movie and series. The same year, OCS signed a long-term agreement with HBO. On October 10, 2013, they launched the channel OCS City (initially nicknamed Génération HBO) to broadcast only HBO productions. The HBO catalog was also available to stream on their streaming service. From 2019 to 2023, OCS had the complete exclusivity on the HBO catalog in France. Before that, other channels like [[Canal+ (French TV channel)|Canal+]], [[Canal+ Séries]] or [[TFX (TV channel)|NT1]] could aired reruns of selected HBO series after their original run on OCS.<ref>{{cite news |date=October 9, 2008 |title=Orange sets November launch for movie bouquet |publisher=broadbandtvnews.com |url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2008/10/09/orange-sets-november-launch-for-movie-bouquet/ |url-status=live |access-date=December 18, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230205030316/https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2008/10/09/orange-sets-november-launch-for-movie-bouquet/ |archive-date=February 5, 2023}}</ref> However, OCS didn't have the rights on the Max catalogue. The deal ended in December 2022, with HBO productions leaving OCS from January 2023 onwards.<ref name="france">{{cite web |last=Elsa Keslassy |date=October 19, 2021 |title=HBO Max France: Canal Plus Executive Vera Peltekian Set to Lead Original Programming (EXCLUSIVE) |url=https://variety.com/2021/global/global/hbo-max-france-vera-peltekian-canal-plus-1235092381/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211019090147/https://variety.com/2021/global/global/hbo-max-france-vera-peltekian-canal-plus-1235092381/ |archive-date=October 19, 2021 |access-date=October 26, 2021 |website=Variety}}</ref>

In October 2021, former [[Canal+ (French TV channel)|Canal+]] executive Vera Peltekian was appointed as VP and commissioning editor of original HBO Max programming for [[France]]. HBO Max's launch in France was set for 2023, but this ended up getting delayed after Warner Bros. Discovery decided to halt the global rollout of HBO Max to replace the existing service with Max first.<ref name="FrancePostponed">{{cite web |date=August 5, 2022 |title=HBO Max ne sortira jamais en France, c'est confirmé |url=https://www.phonandroid.com/hbo-max-ne-sortira-jamais-en-europe-cest-confirme.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230113195010/https://www.phonandroid.com/hbo-max-ne-sortira-jamais-en-europe-cest-confirme.html |archive-date=January 13, 2023 |access-date=February 4, 2023}}</ref> Meanwhile, [[Canal+ (French TV channel)|Canal+]], the [[TF1 Group]], and [[Warner TV]] broadcast a selection of the Warner Bros.-produced scripted live-action Max Original series, certain films and reunion specials. Programs not owned by Warner Bros. (like [[Lionsgate Television|Lionsgate]]'s ''[[Love Life (American TV series)|Love Life]]'') have been licensed separately to other French broadcasters.

In October 2022, [[Amazon Prime Video]] signed a deal with [[Warner Bros. Discovery]] to distribute the HBO Max programs owned by Warner Bros. in France.<ref name="france2">{{cite web |last=Adrien Delage |date=October 18, 2022 |title=Une partie du catalogue HBO Max arrive en France sur Prime Video |url=https://www.konbini.com/biiinge/une-partie-du-catalogue-hbo-max-arrive-en-france-sur-prime-video/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221231173002/https://www.konbini.com/biiinge/une-partie-du-catalogue-hbo-max-arrive-en-france-sur-prime-video/ |archive-date=December 31, 2022 |access-date=December 31, 2022 |website=Konbini}}</ref> In January 2023, it was announced that the deal was extended to all HBO productions, following the expiration of the deal with OCS for HBO productions, but also to Warner Bros. Discovery's linear TV channels, following the end of the deal with [[Canal+ (French TV provider)|Canal+]] for their carriage. All this content where available on the service through Le Pass Warner ("The Warner Pass"), a [[Amazon Prime Video#Amazon Channels|subscription-based channel]], launched on March 16, 2023. Selected programs (like ''[[The Last of Us (TV series)|The Last of Us]]'', ''[[Peacemaker (TV series)|Peacemaker]]'', ''[[Pretty Little Liars: Original Sin]]'' and ''[[The Sex Lives of College Girls]]'') where released without a subscription to the channel for a limited time. The Warner Pass was removed from the service following the launch of Max in France with its subscribers automatically transferred to a Max subscription.<ref name="france3">{{cite web |last=Thibaud Gomès-Léal |date=January 16, 2023 |title=Amazon Prime Video : tout savoir sur le futur Pass Warner |url=https://www.lesnumeriques.com/svod/amazon-prime-video-tout-savoir-sur-le-futur-pass-warner-n203407.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230115163647/https://www.lesnumeriques.com/svod/amazon-prime-video-tout-savoir-sur-le-futur-pass-warner-n203407.html |archive-date=January 15, 2023 |access-date=January 16, 2023 |website=Les Numériques}}</ref>

The service was launched as Max in France on June 11, 2024. In France, the service also include an access to Warner Bros. Discovery's French linear TV channels ([[Warner TV]], [[Warner TV Next]] and others), similar to the service's offer in Poland, and the option to subscribe to a sports-focused add-on that include various live sports events and an access to [[Eurosport]]'s linear channels. During the [[2024 Summer Olympics]], the service shared the broadcast with [[France Télévisions]], and covered the event for all subscribers, even those without the sports add-on.<ref name="FranceDistribution" /><ref name="Europelaunch2" /> The service's ad-free plan is also available as a subscription-based channel on others services like Amazon Prime Video or Canal+.

===== Netherlands and Belgium =====
[[File:HBO Max 2025.svg|thumb|200px|A former variant logo used in Belgium and the Netherlands]]
[[File:HBO Max 2024.svg|thumb|200px|Former variant logo in blue]]
On February 9, 2012, [[HBO Netherlands]] started as a joint venture between HBO and Dutch cable operator [[Ziggo]]. HBO Netherlands aired as a three-channel multiplex service in addition to offering a localized version of [[HBO Go]] to subscribers. HBO Netherlands was not limited to subscribers of Ziggo, instead, many Dutch cable operators offered HBO Netherlands. However, on September 28, 2016, HBO Netherlands announced that it would cease operations on December 31, 2016. That same day, it was announced that Ziggo had bought exclusive rights to HBO programming.<ref>{{cite news |title=HBO-content vanaf 2017 bij Ziggo |date=September 28, 2016 |publisher=Totaal TV |access-date=October 29, 2023 |url=https://www.totaaltv.nl/nieuws/hbo-films-en-series-vanaf-2017-in-nederland-exclusief-bij-ziggo/ |language=nl |archive-date=October 29, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231029224640/https://www.totaaltv.nl/nieuws/hbo-films-en-series-vanaf-2017-in-nederland-exclusief-bij-ziggo/ |url-status=live}}</ref> On November 1, 2016, it was announced that Ziggo will offer HBO programming exclusively as part of their new ''Movies & Series'' service starting from January 2017.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ziggo breidt TV Royaal uit met content van HBO en verhoogt prijs – update |url=https://tweakers.net/nieuws/117397/ziggo-breidt-tv-royaal-uit-met-content-van-hbo-en-verhoogt-prijs.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211215163111/https://tweakers.net/nieuws/117397/ziggo-breidt-tv-royaal-uit-met-content-van-hbo-en-verhoogt-prijs.html |archive-date=December 15, 2021 |access-date=December 15, 2021 |website=Tweakers |language=NL}}</ref> In September 2021, it was reported that Ziggo's rights to HBO programming is set to expire at the end of the year.<ref>{{cite news |title=Ziggo: 'HBO Max in 2022 als streamingdienst in Nederland' |date=September 13, 2021 |publisher=Totaal TV | access-date=October 29, 2023 |url=https://www.totaaltv.nl/nieuws/ziggo-hbo-max-in-2022-als-streamingdienst-in-nederland/ |language=nl |archive-date=October 29, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231029224640/https://www.totaaltv.nl/nieuws/ziggo-hbo-max-in-2022-als-streamingdienst-in-nederland/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Ziggo confirmed that its HBO programming rights are set to expire on January 1, 2022, as a result of WarnerMedia launching HBO Max in The Netherlands in 2022. However, some recently aired seasons will remain on the ''Movies & Series'' service.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ziggo neemt volgend jaar afscheid van meeste HBO-series en -films |url=https://tweakers.net/nieuws/190444/ziggo-neemt-volgend-jaar-afscheid-van-meeste-hbo-series-en-films.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211231105332/https://tweakers.net/nieuws/190444/ziggo-neemt-volgend-jaar-afscheid-van-meeste-hbo-series-en-films.html |archive-date=December 31, 2021 |access-date=December 31, 2021 |website=Tweakers |language=NL}}</ref> On February 1, 2022, the launch date was officially announced for March 8, 2022.<ref name="Europe" />

In Belgium, HBO and Max programing was broadcast through the pay TV operators [[BeTV (Belgium)|BeTV]] and Streamz ([[Telenet (Belgium)|Telenet]]).<ref>{{cite web |date=February 19, 2018 |title=Proximus secures HBO shows with Be TV deal |url=https://www.digitaltveurope.com/2018/02/19/proximus-secures-hbo-shows-with-be-tv-deal/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230228221057/https://www.digitaltveurope.com/2018/02/19/proximus-secures-hbo-shows-with-be-tv-deal/ |archive-date=February 28, 2023 |access-date=February 28, 2023 |publisher=digitaltveurope.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=September 3, 2020 |title=Streamz lanceert op 14 September 2020 in België, vervangt Telenet Play, voegt VRT NU toe |work=MoviePulp |url=https://www.moviepulp.be/356905/streamz-lanceert-op-14-september-2020-in-belgie-vervangt-telenet-play.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210920222331/https://www.moviepulp.be/356905/streamz-lanceert-op-14-september-2020-in-belgie-vervangt-telenet-play.html |archive-date=September 20, 2021 |access-date=September 26, 2021 |author1=Redactie }}</ref>

The Max rebranding in the Netherlands took place on June 11, 2024, alongside a soft launch in Belgium, before its full launch on July 1,<ref name="BeneluxNo3" /><ref name="FranceDistribution" /> but the "HBO Max" name retained due to trademark conflicts with [[Omroep MAX]], a member of the [[Dutch public broadcasting system]], as well as VRT MAX, a streaming platform by the [[VRT (broadcaster)|VRT]].<ref>{{cite web |title=HBO Max wijzigt in Nederland naam toch niet vanwege publieke omroep Max |url=https://tweakers.net/nieuws/214360/hbo-max-wijzigt-in-nederland-naam-toch-niet-vanwege-publieke-omroep-max.html |access-date=October 16, 2023 |website=Tweakers |language=nl |archive-date=October 16, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231016173958/https://tweakers.net/nieuws/214360/hbo-max-wijzigt-in-nederland-naam-toch-niet-vanwege-publieke-omroep-max.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Streamingdienst HBO Max wordt in 2024 beschikbaar in België |url=https://tweakers.net/nieuws/214642/streamingdienst-hbo-max-wordt-in-2024-beschikbaar-in-belgie.html |access-date=October 16, 2023 |website=Tweakers |language=nl}}</ref>

===== Nordic countries and Spain =====
On August 15, 2012, HBO announced plans to launch [[HBO Nordic]], a multiplatform video distribution service serving [[Norway]], [[Denmark]], [[Sweden]] and [[Finland]] that was created through a joint venture with Parsifal International.<ref>[https://www.latimes.com/entertainment/envelope/la-xpm-2012-aug-15-la-et-ct-hbo20th-20120815-story.html HBO and 20th Century Fox renew output deal] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120818102433/http://www.latimes.com/entertainment/envelope/cotown/la-et-ct-hbo20th-20120815,0,5442974.story |date=August 18, 2012}}, ''[[Los Angeles Times]]'', August 15, 2012.</ref><ref>[http://in.reuters.com/article/us-netflixinc-scandinavia-idINBRE87E0JL20120815 Netflix, HBO to battle for Nordic viewers] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160426062137/http://in.reuters.com/article/us-netflixinc-scandinavia-idINBRE87E0JL20120815 |date=April 26, 2016}}, [[Reuters]], August 16, 2012.</ref> The [[video on demand]] service launched in December 2012.<ref>[https://arcticstartup.com/2013/01/08/hbo-nordics-underwhelms-early-adopters HBO Nordic Underwhelms Early Adopters] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150511144258/http://www.arcticstartup.com/2013/01/08/hbo-nordics-underwhelms-early-adopters |date=May 11, 2015}}, ''ArcticStartup'', January 8, 2013.</ref> In Spain, HBO programs were previously broadcast on pay television service [[Canal+ (Spanish TV channel)|Canal+]], since 2011.<ref>[https://www.elcorreogallego.es/movil/hemeroteca/canal-plus-firma-un-acuerdo-hbo-emitir-primicia-mejores-peliculas-emisora-estadounidense-LACG627518 Canal Plus firma un acuerdo con HBO para emitir en primicia las mejores películas de la emisora estadounidense] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211029183635/https://www.elcorreogallego.es/movil/hemeroteca/canal-plus-firma-un-acuerdo-hbo-emitir-primicia-mejores-peliculas-emisora-estadounidense-LACG627518 |date=October 29, 2021}}, elcorreogallego.es</ref> In 2016, during the discontinuation of the Canal+ branding in Spain, HBO launched a standalone streaming service called HBO España, which was the Spanish equivalent of HBO Now and HBO Nordic.

[[HBO Europe]] had announced on multiple occasions that they were not aware that they were going to replace their current service with HBO Max, nor would their rates be increased.<ref>{{cite web |date=April 21, 2020 |title=HBO Max has a release date to stand up to Netflix |url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/series/20200421/48673002356/hbo-max-fecha-lanzamiento.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211208222507/https://www.lavanguardia.com/series/20200421/48673002356/hbo-max-fecha-lanzamiento.html |archive-date=December 8, 2021 |access-date=April 30, 2020 |website=La Vanguardia |language=en}}</ref> However, in December 2020, the head of HBO Max, Andy Forssell, revealed that all HBO services in Europe, including HBO España and HBO Nordic, would be replaced by HBO Max. On October 26, 2021, HBO Max was launched in the Nordics (excluding Iceland) and Spain and Andorra.<ref>{{cite web |last=Keslassy |first=Elsa |date=January 13, 2022 |title=HBO Max France: Arte Executive Clementine Bobin Appointed Senior |url=https://variety.com/2022/tv/global/hbo-max-france-arte-1235153175/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220409004709/https://variety.com/2022/tv/global/hbo-max-france-arte-1235153175/ |archive-date=April 9, 2022 |access-date=April 9, 2022 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=HBO Max arrives in Spain on October 26 |url=https://www.adslzone.net/noticias/streaming-tv/hbo-max-espana-26-octubre/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220120220941/https://www.adslzone.net/noticias/streaming-tv/hbo-max-espana-26-octubre/ |archive-date=January 20, 2022 |access-date=September 8, 2021 |website=ADSLZone |date=September 8, 2021 |language=es}}</ref>

Starting in 2024, HBO Max's programming began to be integrated as part of more expensive packages in the Spanish TV service Movistar Plus+ with all programming from the service becoming available on Movistar Plus+ by April 2024.<ref>{{cite news |title=Movistar Plus+ y Warner Bros. Discovery alcanzan un acuerdo estratégico que formulará la oferta de entretenimiento más competitiva de España|url=https://comunicacion.movistarplus.es/nota-de-prensa/movistar-plus-y-warner-bros-discovery-alcanzan-un-acuerdo-estrategico-que-formulara-la-oferta-de-entretenimiento-mas-competitiva-de-espana/ |agency=[[Movistar Plus+]] |date=December 15, 2023 |access-date=December 18, 2023 |location=Madrid |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |date=April 1, 2024 |title=HBO Max llega a Movistar Plus+ |url=https://comunicacion.movistarplus.es/nota-de-prensa/movistar-plus-ya-ofrece-hbo-max-2/ |access-date=April 3, 2024 |location=Madrid |language=es |work=[[Movistar Plus+]] |archive-date=April 3, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240403221130/https://comunicacion.movistarplus.es/nota-de-prensa/movistar-plus-ya-ofrece-hbo-max-2/ |url-status=live}}</ref> The rebranding to Max went into effect on May 21, 2024.<ref>{{cite web |last1=García |first1=Pedro J. |title=Adiós a HBO Max: Max ya tiene fecha de lanzamiento y planes de suscripción en España |url=https://www.ecartelera.com/noticias/hbo-max-lanzara-espana-mayo-streaming-76704/ |website=eCartelera |access-date=March 21, 2024 |language=Spanish |date=March 21, 2024 |archive-date=March 21, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240321185351/https://www.ecartelera.com/noticias/hbo-max-lanzara-espana-mayo-streaming-76704/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="EuropeLaunch" /> On September 17, 2024, a linear TV channel dedicated to broadcasting HBO and Max content was launched, exclusively on Movistar Plus+, as Max Avances.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.mundoplus.tv/tv-digital/hoy-empieza-a-emitir-max-avances-en-movistar-plus-y-esta-es-su-programacion/ |title=Hoy empieza a emitir Max Avances en Movistar Plus+ y esta es su |date=July 9, 2025 |access-date=July 12, 2025}}</ref>

In [[Iceland]], HBO programming aired on [[Stöð 2]] since 2014, and remained as such even after HBO Max launching in the other Nordic countries.<ref>{{cite web |date=March 12, 2014 |title=Stöð 2 í samstarf við HBO – Vísir |url=https://www.visir.is/g/2014483711d |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220521091447/https://www.visir.is/g/2014483711d |archive-date=May 21, 2022 |access-date=October 29, 2021}}</ref> In 2022, HBO signed an agreement with [[Síminn]] which aired HBO programming on its SVOD service, Sjónvarp Símans Premium. In July 2025, HBO Max was officially launched in Iceland and HBO and Síminn extended their partnership and bundle HBO Max with the Síminn SVOD service.

===== Central and Eastern Europe countries and Portugal =====
In the 2010s, [[HBO Europe]] launched streaming service [[HBO Go]] in 13 [[Central and Eastern Europe]]an countries. HBO programs in Portugal were previously broadcast on the premium television channel TVSéries from the services of [[TVCine]], since 2015. In 2019, less than a year before the discontinuation of TVSeries, HBO Europe launched a standalone streaming service called [[HBO Portugal]]. Similarly to the Nordics and Spain, HBO Max was launched in Portugal<ref>{{cite web |title=HBO Max chega a Portugal em março |url=https://mag.sapo.pt/tv/atualidade-tv/artigos/hbo-max-chega-a-portugal-em-marco |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220204170149/https://mag.sapo.pt/amp/tv/atualidade-tv/artigos/hbo-max-chega-a-portugal-em-marco |archive-date=February 4, 2022 |access-date=February 4, 2022 |website=mag.sapo.pt}}</ref> and Central and Eastern Europe on March 8, 2022,<ref name="Europe2022">{{cite web |date=February 2022 |title=HBO Max is expanding to 15 more countries in March – TechCrunch |url=https://techcrunch.com/2022/02/01/hbo-max-is-expanding-to-15-more-countries-in-march/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220204152846/https://techcrunch.com/2022/02/01/hbo-max-is-expanding-to-15-more-countries-in-march/ |archive-date=February 4, 2022 |access-date=February 4, 2022}}</ref> respectively replacing HBO Portugal and HBO Go.

The rebranding to Max went into effect on May 21, 2024,<ref name="EuropeLaunch" /> except in Poland where it took place on June 11.<ref name="FranceDistribution">{{cite web |url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2024/05/07/max-to-be-distributed-by-canal-and-prime-video-in-france-new-launches-announced/ |title=Max to be distributed by Canal and Prime Video in France; new launches announced |language=en |work=Broadband TV News |date=May 7, 2024 |access-date=May 7, 2024 |archive-date=May 8, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240508021536/https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2024/05/07/max-to-be-distributed-by-canal-and-prime-video-in-france-new-launches-announced/ |url-status=live}}</ref> All of these were reverted again into HBO Max globally just a years later. The Max rebranding in Poland also gave the option to live stream all of [[TVN Warner Bros. Discovery]]'s linear television networks as part of the Sports add-on, except Cinemax 1 and Cinemax 2. Meanwhile, Polish users not subscribed to extra add-on will be able to only live stream the three [[HBO Europe|HBO]] channels in Poland and the free to air network [[TVN (Polish TV channel)|TVN]].

===== Turkey, Greece, and post-Soviet states =====
Plans to introduce HBO Max in Turkey, Greece and the [[Baltic states]], where HBO Go was absent, were announced in October 2021,<ref>{{cite news |last=Lang |first=Jamie |date=October 5, 2021 |title=HBO Max Unveils New Territories, Pricing and 45-Day Theatrical-to-Streaming Window in Europe |url=https://variety.com/2021/streaming/global/hbo-max-territories-pricing-theatrical-europe-1235081132/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211005095323/https://variety.com/2021/streaming/global/hbo-max-territories-pricing-theatrical-europe-1235081132/ |archive-date=October 5, 2021 |access-date=October 5, 2021 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> but these plans were later halted following the creation of Warner Bros. Discovery, with [[Vodafone Greece|Vodafone]] TV in Greece,<ref name="Greece">{{cite news |last=Αχείλα |first=Κωνσταντίνα |date=February 7, 2023 |title=Οι ταινίες της Warner Bros. διαθέσιμες μέσω του Vodafone TV |url=https://gr.ign.com/warner-bros/104253/news/oi-tainies-tes-warner-bros-diathesimes-meso-tou-vodafone-tv |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230209185003/https://gr.ign.com/warner-bros/104253/news/oi-tainies-tes-warner-bros-diathesimes-meso-tou-vodafone-tv |archive-date=February 9, 2023 |access-date=February 7, 2023 |work=[[IGN]]}}</ref> various TV operators in Turkey, including [[Digiturk]],<ref name="Turkey">{{cite news |date=October 6, 2022 |title=House of Dragon'un Türkiye'deki yayın adresi belli oldu: 7 Ekim'de Bein Connect'te |url=https://www.diken.com.tr/house-of-dragonun-turkiyedeki-yayin-adresi-belli-oldu-7-ekimde-bein-connectte/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230209192630/https://www.diken.com.tr/house-of-dragonun-turkiyedeki-yayin-adresi-belli-oldu-7-ekimde-bein-connectte/ |archive-date=February 9, 2023 |access-date=February 9, 2023}}</ref> and [[TV3 Group (Baltics)|Go3]] and [[Telia Company|Telia]] in the Baltic states<ref>{{cite web |date=June 26, 2023 |title=Warner Bros. Discovery inks Baltics Go3 deal |url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2023/06/26/warner-bros-discovery-inks-baltics-go3-deal/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230628185626/https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2023/06/26/warner-bros-discovery-inks-baltics-go3-deal/ |archive-date=June 28, 2023 |access-date=February 2, 2024 |work=Broadband TV News |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=June 22, 2023 |title=Warner Bros. Discovery expands Telia partnership |url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2023/06/22/warner-bros-discovery-expands-telia-partnership/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230705182415/https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2023/06/22/warner-bros-discovery-expands-telia-partnership/ |archive-date=July 5, 2023 |access-date=February 2, 2024 |work=Broadband TV News |language=en}}</ref> instead getting the rights for various HBO and Max programming.

On December 6, 2023, [[Warner Bros. Discovery]] (WBD) fully acquired the Turkish streaming service [[BluTV]],<ref>{{cite web |date=December 7, 2023 |title=Warner Bros-Discovery Fully Acquires BluTV |url=https://www.medyaradar.com/warner-bros-discovery-blutvnin-tamamini-satin-aldi-haberi-2151522 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231207181116/https://www.medyaradar.com/warner-bros-discovery-blutvnin-tamamini-satin-aldi-haberi-2151522 |archive-date=December 7, 2023 |access-date=December 7, 2023 |work=medyaradar.com |language=tr-TR}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Shafer |first=Ellise |date=December 29, 2023 |title=Warner Bros. In Greece, the offer present in Vodafone TV was relaunched as Max on February 20, 2025, and all Max content was made available across all TV packages in Vodafone Greece.<ref name="Greece2">{{cite web |last=Clover |first=Julian |title=Vodafone TV partners with Warner Bros. Discovery for Max Greece launch |url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2025/02/21/vodafone-tv-partners-with-warner-bros-discovery-for-max-greece-launch/ |language=en |work=Broadband TV News |date=February 21, 2025 |access-date=February 21, 2025}}</ref> On January 13, 2026, marked the launch date of HBO Max as a standalone service in Greece.

On June 10, 2025, it was announced that HBO Max would finally launch in the Baltic states, as well as in other [[post-Soviet states]], including Armenia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan, on July 22, 2025. Launches for Albania, Cyprus, and Malta were also announced for that same time frame.<ref name="HollywoodReporter" />

===== United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, and Italy =====
Under a long-term agreement until 2025 between HBO and [[Sky Group]] ([[Comcast]]), Sky operates [[Sky Atlantic]] which broadcasts the majority of HBO's programming. Sky Atlantic is available in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, and Italy. In February 2011, [[Sky Atlantic]] launched on the Sky platforms in the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], which maintains a distribution deal with HBO to offer the majority of its programming on the channel. Under the five-year agreement between HBO and Sky, newer HBO programs will air on Sky Atlantic before airing on other television channels within the United Kingdom and Ireland. Before 2011, [[TG4]] in Ireland had a long-term agreement to broadcast HBO programming free-to-air, this ceased following the creation of Sky Atlantic. In many other countries, HBO Max has licensed exclusive rights to its programming to television networks owned by third parties, including [[Sky Atlantic]] in the [[United Kingdom]].

In March 2021, WarnerMedia confirmed that HBO Max would not launch in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, and Italy before 2025 due to an existing deal for HBO programming with [[Sky Group]] which was renewed in 2019 but does not automatically include Max Originals produced by third-party companies or Warner Bros. Television themselves.<ref>{{cite web |date=March 24, 2021 |title=HBO Max UK launch delayed until 2025 |work=RXTV |url=https://rxtvinfo.com/2021/hbo-max-uk-launch-delayed-until-2025 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210324115949/https://rxtvinfo.com/2021/hbo-max-uk-launch-delayed-until-2025 |archive-date=March 24, 2021 |access-date=March 24, 2021 |publisher=RX:TV}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Easton |first=Jonathan |date=March 23, 2021 |title=Sky deal behind delayed HBO Max rollout, Kilar confirms |url=https://www.digitaltveurope.com/2021/03/23/sky-deal-behind-delayed-hbo-max-rollout-kilar-confirms/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210323202716/https://www.digitaltveurope.com/2021/03/23/sky-deal-behind-delayed-hbo-max-rollout-kilar-confirms/ |archive-date=March 23, 2021 |access-date=March 24, 2021 |website=Digital TV Europe}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Nicolaou |first1=Anna |last2=Barker |first2=Alex |date=March 23, 2021 |title=Licensing deals put brakes on HBO Max rollout in Europe |work=Financial Times |url=https://www.ft.com/content/753098d2-2b26-425f-92af-6e413800f74e |url-status=live |access-date=March 24, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210324113807/https://www.ft.com/content/753098d2-2b26-425f-92af-6e413800f74e |archive-date=March 24, 2021}}</ref>

On December 9, 2024, Warner Bros. Discovery and Sky announced a brand new non-exclusive bundling partnership in the UK and Ireland, where HBO Max is expected to launch in March 2026. Following its launch, Sky customers will gain access to the ad-supported version of HBO Max at no additional cost.<ref name="SkyUKIreland">{{cite web |last=Goldsmith |first=Jill |date=December 9, 2024 |title=Warner Bros. Discovery, Comcast Ink Distribution Deals Across Xfinity & Sky; Peacock Parent To Package Max, Discovery+ In Streaming Bundles |url=https://deadline.com/2024/12/warner-bros-discovery-comcast-multi-year-distribution-deals-xfinity-and-sky-1236197962/ |access-date=December 9, 2024 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |language=en-US |archive-date=December 9, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241209153405/https://deadline.com/2024/12/warner-bros-discovery-comcast-multi-year-distribution-deals-xfinity-and-sky-1236197962/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

HBO Max launched on January 13, 2026 in Germany, Italy, Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg, and Liechtenstein.<ref>{{cite news |date=December 3, 2025 |title=HBO Max Nears Full Availability Across Europe With January 13 Launches In Key Markets Including Germany And Italy |url=https://press.wbd.com/us/media-release/hbo-max-nears-full-availability-across-europe-january-13-launches-key-markets |access-date=December 5, 2025}}</ref> The service launched on March 26, 2026 in the UK and Ireland, completing its European roll-out.<ref>{{cite news |date=December 3, 2025 |title=HBO Max Sets March 2026 Launch in U.K., Ireland |work=Variety |url=https://variety.com/2025/tv/global/hbo-max-uk-ireland-launch-march-2026-1236598902/ |access-date=January 2, 2026}}</ref>

==== Asia-Pacific ====

===== Australia and New Zealand =====
[[Fox Showcase]], an Australian premium television service, began airing HBO original programming in 2012, through a licensed distribution arrangement with subscription television provider [[Foxtel]]. Before this, limited HBO content was broadcast through the now-defunct [[Movie Network Channels|Movie Network]], which was founded by HBO (through [[Time Warner]]), [[Village Roadshow]], [[Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer]] and [[Disney–ABC International Television]]. HBO Originals are also available on-demand via Foxtel services [[Foxtel Now]] and [[Binge (streaming service)|Binge]]. [[Sky Movies (New Zealand)|Sky Movies]] in [[New Zealand]] originally operated as a joint venture between HBO and [[Sky Network Television]]. The channel was renamed HBO in 1993; Time Warner later sold its share in the service to Sky in 1998, and it was renamed back to Sky Movies. HBO programming is currently shown by Sky channel [[HBO (New Zealand)|HBO]], and its subscription streaming service [[Neon (service)|Neon]], in New Zealand. Deals with some other partners including [[Foxtel]] in Australia and [[Sky (New Zealand)|Sky]] in New Zealand which includes a significant portion of HBO Max's original programming were agreed or renewed between 2019 and 2021.<ref name="finder-foxtel" /><ref name="stuff-sky">{{cite web |last=Pullar-Strecker |first=Tom |date=August 27, 2021 |title=HBO Max shows heading to Sky TV after it extends and expands Warner deal |url=https://www.stuff.co.nz/business/126201902/hbo-max-shows-heading-to-sky-tv-after-it-extends-and-expands-warner-deal |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210911141054/https://www.stuff.co.nz/business/126201902/hbo-max-shows-heading-to-sky-tv-after-it-extends-and-expands-warner-deal |archive-date=September 11, 2021 |access-date=September 11, 2021 |website=Stuff}}</ref><ref name="Stop Press 22 Oct 2024">{{cite web |title=Sky New Zealand and Warner Bros Discovery announce new partnership |url=https://stoppress.co.nz/news/sky-new-zealand-and-warner-bros-discovery-announce-new-partnership/ |website=StopPress |access-date=23 October 2024 |date=22 October 2024 |archive-date=November 5, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241105101326/https://stoppress.co.nz/news/sky-new-zealand-and-warner-bros-discovery-announce-new-partnership/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

Foxtel and Warner Bros Discovery renewed their partnership in February 2023, making HBO and Warner Bros. content available across Foxtel's pay-TV channels as well as its Foxtel Now and Binge streaming services.<ref name="FoxtelDeal">{{cite web |last=patrick Brzeski |date=February 28, 2023 |title=Australia's Foxtel Inks Multi-Year Deal to Retain Warner Bros. Discovery Content |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/foxtel-deal-warner-bros-discovery-hbo-max-content-1235338393/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230303204016/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/foxtel-deal-warner-bros-discovery-hbo-max-content-1235338393/ |archive-date=March 3, 2023 |access-date=March 3, 2023 |website=The Hollywood Reporter}}</ref> In mid-October 2024, [[Warner Bros. Discovery|Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD)]] and Sky New Zealand signed a new partnership agreement that would allow Sky to remain the exclusive distributor of both [[HBO]] and Max content in New Zealand from October 30, 2024. Under the partnership, Sky New Zealand would host Max as a hub on its Sky Box, Sky Pod and [[Sky (New Zealand)#Sky Go|Sky Go]] platforms and its Neon streaming service. The SoHo channel would also be revamped as a linear HBO channel featuring [[List of HBO original programming|HBO Original]] content.<ref name="Stop Press 22 Oct 2024" /><ref>{{cite news |last1=Keall |first1=Chris |title=Sky TV heads off local launch of HBO's direct-to-consumer Max app with new Warner Bros Discovery deal |url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/sky-tv-heads-off-local-launch-of-hbos-direct-to-consumer-max-with-expanded-warner-bros-discovery-deal/JLZKAOARHZCK3MVMVJRCTXVKRU/ |access-date=23 October 2024 |work=[[The New Zealand Herald]] |date=22 October 2024 |archive-date=October 21, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241021204146/https://www.nzherald.co.nz/business/sky-tv-heads-off-local-launch-of-hbos-direct-to-consumer-max-with-expanded-warner-bros-discovery-deal/JLZKAOARHZCK3MVMVJRCTXVKRU/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

On February 25, 2025, WBD announced that Max would be launched as a standalone service in Australia on March 31, 2025.<ref name="AustraliaLaunch">{{cite web |date=2025-02-25 |title=Warner Bros. Discovery To Launch Max Streaming Service In Australia On March 31 |url=https://press.wbd.com/us/media-release/warner-bros-discovery-launch-max-streaming-service-australia-march-31 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250226124351/https://press.wbd.com/us/media-release/warner-bros-discovery-launch-max-streaming-service-australia-march-31 |archive-date=2025-02-26 |access-date=2025-02-26 |website=Warner Bros. ===== Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, Macau, Mongolia, and Taiwan =====
In June 2021, WarnerMedia appointed a managing director for the launch of HBO Max in eight territories across Southeast Asia.<ref name="saindia">{{cite web |last=Frater |first=Patrick |date=June 3, 2021 |title=Amit Malhotra to Lead HBO Max Rollout in Southeast Asia |url=https://variety.com/2021/streaming/asia/amit-malhotra-hbo-max-asia-1234988598/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211102034027/https://variety.com/2021/streaming/asia/amit-malhotra-hbo-max-asia-1234988598/ |archive-date=November 2, 2021 |access-date=November 2, 2021 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref>

In 2023, HBO Max was planned to launch in selected Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong and Taiwan, but the launch was postponed until late 2024.<ref name="Maas"/> Finally, the service launched as Max in Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Singapore, the Philippines, Hong Kong, and Taiwan on November 19, 2024, replacing the [[HBO Go]] Asia services.<ref>{{cite web |last=Frater |first=Patrick |date=2024-10-15 |title=Max Confirmed to Launch in Seven Asian Territories in November |url=https://variety.com/2024/tv/news/max-launch-asia-territories-november-1236178181/ |access-date=2024-10-15 |website=Variety |language=en-US |archive-date=November 22, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241122025644/https://variety.com/2024/tv/news/max-launch-asia-territories-november-1236178181/ |url-status=live}}</ref> The service later expanded to Brunei, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Timor-Leste, as well as Macau and Mongolia on October 15, 2025.

HBO Max was launched in Vietnam on June 16, 2026, replacing the former HBO Go services.<ref name="VietnamLaunch" />

===== India and South Asia =====
In June 2021, HBO Max has begun the exploration of the possibilities to launch HBO Max in the [[India]]n market.<ref name="saindia"/> Warner Bros. Discovery India decided to premiere their HBO Max original programming, including their original films, on [[Amazon Prime Video]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Ramachandran |first=Naman |date=July 18, 2022 |title='The Flight Attendant,' 'Peacemaker' Among HBO Max Shows Premiering on Amazon Prime Video India – Global Bulletin |url=https://variety.com/2022/tv/global/hbo-max-shows-amazon-prime-video-india-1235318673/#! |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220804165119/https://variety.com/2022/tv/global/hbo-max-shows-amazon-prime-video-india-1235318673/#! |archive-date=August 4, 2022 |access-date=August 4, 2022 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> It later started to gradually migrate to [[Viacom18]]'s [[JioCinema]] from May 13, 2023 onwards and finished by late 2023.<ref name="Singh">{{cite web |last=Singh |first=Manish |date=April 27, 2023 |title=Warner Bros. partners with James Murdoch-backed Viacom18 to bring Succession, other HBO content to India |url=https://techcrunch.com/2023/04/27/warner-bros-partners-with-james-murdoch-backed-viacom18-to-bring-succession-other-hbo-content-to-india/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230427081651/https://techcrunch.com/2023/04/27/warner-bros-partners-with-james-murdoch-backed-viacom18-to-bring-succession-other-hbo-content-to-india/ |archive-date=April 27, 2023 |access-date=April 27, 2023 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name="variety.com">{{cite web |last1=Ramachandran |first1=Naman |last2=Frater |first2=Patrick |date=April 27, 2023 |title=Viacom18-JioCinema Secures HBO, Max Original and Warner Bros. Content for India |url=https://variety.com/2023/global/news/viacom18-jiocinema-india-hbo-warner-1235596330/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230427200723/https://variety.com/2023/global/news/viacom18-jiocinema-india-hbo-warner-1235596330/ |archive-date=April 27, 2023 |access-date=April 28, 2023 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> On February 14, 2025, JioCinema merged with Disney+ Hotstar to form JioHotstar which integrates HBO contents that were previously on JioCinema.<ref>{{cite news |date=February 14, 2025 |title=JioHotstar launch: Here's what happens to your existing JioCinema, Disney+ Hotstar subscription |newspaper=[[Hindustan Times]] |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/jiohotstar-launch-heres-what-happens-to-your-existing-jiocinema-disney-hotst-subscription-101739524953891.html |archive-date=February 15, 2025 |access-date=February 28, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250215001501/https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/jiohotstar-launch-heres-what-happens-to-your-existing-jiocinema-disney-hotst-subscription-101739524953891.html |url-status=live}}</ref> On April 15, 2026, HBO Max was introduced as an integrated brand hub within JioHotstar in India, consolidating content from HBO, Warner Bros., DC, the Wizarding World, Max Originals, and selected Cartoon Network titles into a single platform, while Discovery+ remains available as a standalone service.<ref name="JioHotstar">{{cite web |last=Ramachandran |first=Naman |date=April 15, 2026 |title='Euphoria' Season 3 Leads HBO Max Launch on JioHotstar as Warner Bros. Discovery Expands India Partnership |url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/euphoria-season-3-hbo-max-launch-jiohotstar-india-1236722184/ |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |language=en-US |access-date=April 15, 2026}}</ref>

On September 15, 2025, WBD announced that HBO Max would be launched as a standalone service in Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal, and Sri Lanka on October 15, 2025.<ref name="14MarketAsia">{{cite web |last=Ramachandran |first=Naman |date=September 16, 2025 |title=HBO Max Continues Asia Pacific Expansion With 14-Market Launch |url=https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/hbo-max-asia-pacific-expansion-1236520167/ |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |access-date=September 16, 2025}}</ref> It later expanded to Bhutan and the Maldives on March 26, 2026.

===== Japan =====
In Japan, [[U-Next]] reached a deal to carry HBO and HBO Max original programs in Japan beginning on April 1, 2021. This replaced a previous deal between HBO and [[Amazon Prime Video]] Japan.<ref name="Schilling">{{cite web |last=Schilling |first=Mark |date=March 31, 2021 |title=HBO Max Content to Stream on Japan's U-Next Platform |url=https://variety.com/2021/streaming/asia/hbo-max-content-japan-u-next-platform-1234941502/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210402073026/https://variety.com/2021/streaming/asia/hbo-max-content-japan-u-next-platform-1234941502/ |archive-date=April 2, 2021 |access-date=April 5, 2021 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> This deal between Warner Bros. Discovery and U-Next was renewed in March 2023, making the streaming service the home of HBO content in the country in a "multi-year" deal between the two. On September 18, 2024, Warner Bros. Discovery signed an exclusive partnership agreement with U-Next. The deal allows Max to launch within the U-Next system featuring a library of more than 2,500 works and 16,000 episodes from 8 brands including HBO, Max Originals, ''[[Harry Potter (film series)|Harry Potter]]'', DC, Warner Bros., Cartoon Network, Discovery Channel, and Animal Planet. It officially launched on September 25, 2024.<ref name="Unext">{{cite web |title=全世界1億人超の会員を有するワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー。主力の動画サービス「Max」が日本上陸、U-NEXT内に登場。日本コンテンツの海外配信においても協業し、U-NEXTから日本IPを世界に発信 |url=https://www.unext.co.jp/ja/press-room/max-coming-to-unext-2024-09-19 |website=U-NEXTコーポレート |access-date=2024-09-19 |publisher=株式会社U-NEXT |date=2024-09-19 |language=ja}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=U-NEXT 、動画配信サービス「Max」独占配信 |url=https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUC193A10Z10C24A9000000/ |website=日本経済新聞 |date=2024-09-19 |access-date=2024-09-21 |language=ja |archive-date=September 23, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240923230524/https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOUC193A10Z10C24A9000000/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Starting on October 1, 2026, the HBO Max library would move to [[Hulu Japan|Hulu]] and [[Amazon Prime Video]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2026/08/hbo-max-launch-japan-amazon-hulu-1237063387/|title=HBO Max To Launch In Japan As Hub Within Prime Video & Hulu |work=Deadline |date=2026-08-31 |access-date=2026-09-11}}</ref>

===== Mainland China and South Korea =====
In Mainland China and South Korea, HBO Max exclusively operates through third-party distribution partners.

In Mainland China, regulatory restrictions prevent HBO Max from operating as a standalone subscription service. Consequently, content distribution is conducted via licensing agreements with domestic digital platforms [[Tencent Video]] and [[Bilibili]], respectively for TV series and for movies.

In South Korea, HBO Max content is distributed through specialized licensing agreements with local platforms [[SK Telecom]] (via the Wavve service) and [[Coupang Play]]. As of March 21, 2025, Coupang Play became the exclusive streaming home for the full slate of HBO and Max original content in South Korea, and as of 2026 all Wavve-distributed contents migrated to Coupang Play.

==== Middle East and North Africa ====
[[OSN]] currently carries HBO, Discovery+, some Cartoon Network series, some Warner Bros. movies and series content across 22 countries in the Middle East and North Africa region on its linear channels as well as its [[OSN#OSN+ (OSN Plus)|OSN+]] streaming service. An exclusive, multi-year licensing deal was renewed in March 2023, meaning a HBO Max launch is unlikely in this region in the near future.

== Reception ==

=== As HBO Max ===
HBO Max received mixed reception from media observers on launch. The range of available content was generally well received, but many commented on the likelihood of confusion with HBO's other since-deprecated streaming platforms, HBO Go and HBO Now, and the service's higher subscription price compared to other newly launched streaming platforms like [[Disney+]].<ref name="variety-hbo-confusion" /><ref>{{cite web |last=Alexander |first=Julia |date=May 26, 2020 |title=HBO Max is full of potential, but its biggest hurdle remains AT&T's messy execution |url=https://www.theverge.com/2020/5/26/21268490/hbo-max-launch-price-warnermedia-att-dc-harry-potter-friends-disney-netflix-peacock |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200911170743/https://www.theverge.com/2020/5/26/21268490/hbo-max-launch-price-warnermedia-att-dc-harry-potter-friends-disney-netflix-peacock |archive-date=September 11, 2020 |access-date=September 10, 2020 |website=[[The Verge]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Jurgensen |first=John |date=May 27, 2020 |title=HBO Max Is Here: What You Need to Know |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/hbo-max-is-here-what-you-need-to-know-11590580677 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200820234622/https://www.wsj.com/articles/hbo-max-is-here-what-you-need-to-know-11590580677 |archive-date=August 20, 2020 |access-date=September 10, 2020 |website=[[The Wall Street Journal]]}}</ref> Television critics also expressed frustration that the [[List of Cinemax original programming|library of original series]] (not including its former late night adult content) for sister network Cinemax was not originally available on HBO Max, though much of its output had arrived on the service by the end of 2021.<ref>{{cite news |last=Thomas |first=Kaitlin |date=October 2, 2020 |title=A Plea for HBO Max to Add Banshee and More Great Cinemax Originals to Its Streaming Library |work=[[TV Guide]] |url=https://www.tvguide.com/news/hbo-max-should-add-cinemax-shows-banshee-the-knick-strike-back/ |url-status=live |access-date=December 13, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210112004213/https://www.tvguide.com/news/hbo-max-should-add-cinemax-shows-banshee-the-knick-strike-back/ |archive-date=January 12, 2021}}</ref>

AT&T announced in July 2020 that HBO Max had nominally achieved 26.6&nbsp;million subscribers after its first month of operation, including 23.6&nbsp;million wholesale customers, primarily legacy HBO pay TV subscribers that were covered by new agreements that added access to HBO Max at no extra charge.<ref name="vty-first-subs">{{cite web |last=Bridge |first=Gavin |date=July 23, 2020 |title=HBO Max Subscriber Math Demystified |url=https://variety.com/vip/hbo-max-subscriber-math-demystified-1234715002/#! |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200725001440/https://variety.com/vip/hbo-max-subscriber-math-demystified-1234715002/ |archive-date=July 25, 2020 |access-date=September 23, 2020 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety Intelligence Platform]]}}</ref> However, only 4.1&nbsp;million customers had activated their HBO Max accounts by the same date.<ref name="vty-first-subs" /> The latter figure was seen by many observers as a disappointment, particularly in light of Disney+ having reached 10 million subscribers within a day of launch; ''[[The New York Times]]''<nowiki/>'s media critic [[Ben Smith (journalist)|Ben Smith]] wrote that WarnerMedia had "badly botched" the launch.<ref>{{cite web |last=Smith |first=Ben |author-link=Ben Smith (journalist) |date=August 16, 2020 |title=The Week Old Hollywood Finally, Actually Died |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2020/08/16/business/media/hollywood-studios-firings-streaming.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200909133853/https://www.nytimes.com/2020/08/16/business/media/hollywood-studios-firings-streaming.html |archive-date=September 9, 2020 |access-date=September 10, 2020 |website=[[The New York Times]]}}</ref>

However, AT&T executives contended that it had been a "flawless launch" citing increased customer engagement compared to HBO Now and overall growth in total subscriptions to either HBO or HBO Max (36.3&nbsp;million, vs. 34.6&nbsp;million HBO or HBO Now subscribers at the end of 2019), while acknowledging that there was more to do to persuade existing HBO subscribers to start using the HBO Max apps.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Spangler |first1=Todd |last2=Littleton |first2=Cynthia |date=July 23, 2020 |title=HBO Max and HBO Have 36.3 Million Subscribers, Up 5% From End of 2019, AT&T Says |url=https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/hbo-max-subscribers-subscribers-q2-att-1234714316/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200915100822/https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/hbo-max-subscribers-subscribers-q2-att-1234714316/ |archive-date=September 15, 2020 |access-date=September 10, 2020 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> Executives had previously noted that HBO Max was starting from a different place than other streaming services as it was building on the existing HBO subscriber base, and had to work within the constraints of many of HBO's pre-existing deals (such as those with Amazon and Roku).<ref>{{cite web |last=Alexander |first=Julia |date=July 23, 2020 |title=HBO Max has more than 4 million subscribers, AT&T says |url=https://www.theverge.com/2020/7/23/21334541/hbo-max-subscribers-att-earnings-amazon-roku-warnermedia |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200916154609/https://www.theverge.com/2020/7/23/21334541/hbo-max-subscribers-att-earnings-amazon-roku-warnermedia |archive-date=September 16, 2020 |access-date=September 10, 2020 |website=[[The Verge]]}}</ref>

In October 2020, AT&T revealed that the number of activated HBO Max subscribers had reached 8.6&nbsp;million by the end of September, while the number of nominal (eligible) subscribers reached 28.7&nbsp;million. The total number of HBO / HBO Max subscriptions in the U.S. also increased to 28 million.<ref name="vty-subs-q3-2020">{{cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=October 22, 2020 |title=HBO Max Hits 28.7 Million Subscribers in Q3, Warner Bros. Revenue Down 28% |url=https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/hbo-max-28-million-subscribers-q3-att-earnings-1234813032/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201022122229/https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/hbo-max-28-million-subscribers-q3-att-earnings-1234813032/ |archive-date=October 22, 2020 |access-date=October 22, 2020 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> With an agreement being reached the following month with Amazon (which is reported to have had 5 million HBO subscribers through Prime Video Channels), the number of HBO Max-eligible subscribers is understood to have increased to over 33&nbsp;million.<ref name="vty-amazon-deal" /> In September 2022, Warner Bros. Discovery was sued by a shareholder, alleging that WarnerMedia had overstated the number of HBO Max subscribers by including unactivated subscriptions bundled with AT&T services.<ref>{{cite web |date=September 28, 2022 |title=Warner Bros. Discovery faces suit alleging inflated HBO Max numbers |author-first1=Meg |author-last1=James |url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/business/story/2022-09-28/warner-bros-discovery-shareholder-lawsuit-hbo-subscribers |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220929155042/https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/business/story/2022-09-28/warner-bros-discovery-shareholder-lawsuit-hbo-subscribers |archive-date=September 29, 2022 |access-date=September 29, 2022 |website=Los Angeles Times |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=September 27, 2022 |title=Warner Bros. Discovery Inflated HBO Max Subscribers, Lawsuit Claims |url=https://www.thewrap.com/warner-bros-discovery-hbo-max-subscribers-class-action-lawsuit/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220929155044/https://www.thewrap.com/warner-bros-discovery-hbo-max-subscribers-class-action-lawsuit/ |archive-date=September 29, 2022 |access-date=September 29, 2022 |website=[[TheWrap]] |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== As Max ===
Upon its launch, it was noted that Max had grouped directors and writers for its films and television series under a singular "creators" credit.<ref>{{cite web |last=Sakoui |first=Anousha |date=May 24, 2023 |title=Max vows to change back credits as writers and directors blast streamer |url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/business/story/2023-05-24/max-new-credits-writers-directors-angry |access-date=May 25, 2023 |website=Los Angeles Times |language=en-US}}</ref> The [[Directors Guild of America]] and [[Writers Guild of America West]] condemned the move amidst the [[2023 Hollywood labor disputes]]. Max announced that they would fix the credits, agreeing with the outcry from the guilds regarding proper credit for its creators, noting the altered credits were a result of "an oversight in the technical transition" from HBO Max to Max.<ref>{{cite web |last=Spangler |first=Todd |date=May 24, 2023 |title=Max Will Change Film Credit Listings to Break Out Directors and Writers After Backlash Over 'Creators' Heading |url=https://variety.com/2023/digital/news/max-film-credit-listings-change-directors-writers-backlash-1235624049/ |access-date=May 25, 2023 |website=Variety |language=en-US |archive-date=May 25, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230525074733/https://variety.com/2023/digital/news/max-film-credit-listings-change-directors-writers-backlash-1235624049/ |url-status=live}}</ref> ''Deadline Hollywood'' reported the consolidation was a result of WBD's IT departments creating the "catch all" for the credits to be in place for launch, and that executives, who could have intervened, had been unaware of the single credit until the discourse arose online after its launch. Additionally, it was reported that it would take "weeks" to fix, given the service would need to make the adjustment on each platform.<ref>{{cite web |last=Patten |first=Dominic |date=May 26, 2023 |title=Max Credits Snafu Could Take Weeks To Fix; Execs Didn't Know About New "Creators" Label Until After Launch |url=https://deadline.com/2023/05/succession-max-credits-error-fix-writers-strike-hbo-david-zaslav-wga-dga-1235381411/ |access-date=May 26, 2023 |website=Deadline Hollywood}}</ref> The credits would later be fixed, beginning in late June.<ref>{{cite web |last=Patten |first=Dominic |date=June 28, 2023 |title=Warner Bros Discovery's Fix Of Insulting "Creator" Credits On Max Finally Begins Rollout |url=https://deadline.com/2023/06/succession-credits-fix-creators-max-hbo-warner-bros-discovery-wga-1235426330/ |access-date=June 29, 2023 |website=Deadline Hollywood |archive-date=June 29, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230629023700/https://deadline.com/2023/06/succession-credits-fix-creators-max-hbo-warner-bros-discovery-wga-1235426330/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

'''HTTP Live Streaming''' (also known as '''HLS''') is an [[HTTP]]-based [[adaptive bitrate streaming]] communications protocol developed by [[Apple Inc.]] and released in 2009. Support for the protocol is widespread in media players, web browsers, mobile devices, and streaming media servers. {{As of|2022}}, an annual video industry survey has consistently found it to be the most popular streaming format.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Lederer |first1=Stefan |title=2022 Video Developer Report |url=https://bitmovin.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/bitmovin-6th-video-developer-report-2022-2023.pdf |website=Bitmovin |access-date=25 October 2023 |language=en}}</ref>

HLS resembles [[MPEG-DASH]] in that it works by breaking the overall stream into a sequence of small HTTP-based file downloads, each downloading one short chunk of an overall potentially unbounded transport stream. A list of available streams, encoded at different bit rates, is sent to the client using an extended M3U playlist.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://larryjordan.com/articles/basics-of-http-live-streaming|title= The Basics of HTTP Live Streaming|last= Jordan|first= Larry|date= 10 June 2013|work= Larry's Blog|publisher= Larry Jordan & Associates|access-date= 18 June 2013}}</ref>

Based on standard HTTP transactions, HTTP Live Streaming can traverse any [[Firewall (computing)|firewall]] or [[proxy server]] that lets through standard HTTP traffic, unlike UDP-based protocols such as [[Real-time Transport Protocol|RTP]]. This also allows content to be offered from conventional HTTP servers and delivered over widely available HTTP-based [[content delivery network]]s.<ref>{{cite web |date=March 29, 2015 |title=MPEG-DASH vs. Apple HLS vs. Smooth Streaming vs. Adobe HDS |url=https://bitmovin.com/mpeg-dash-vs-apple-hls-vs-microsoft-smooth-streaming-vs-adobe-hds/ |website=Bitmovin}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last1=Chen |first1=Songqing |last2=Shen |first2=Bo |last3=Tan |first3=Wai-tian |last4=Wee |first4=Susie |last5=Zhang |first5=Xiaodong |title=2006 IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo |chapter=A Case for Internet Streaming via Web Servers |date=2006-07-09 |pages=2145–2148 |doi=10.1109/ICME.2006.262660 |isbn=978-1-4244-0367-7 |issn=1945-7871 |eissn=1945-788X |s2cid=9202042 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Songqing Chen |last2=Bo Shen |last3=Wee |first3=S. |last4=Xiaodong Zhang |date=2007-07-23 |title=SProxy: A Caching Infrastructure to Support Internet Streaming |journal=IEEE Transactions on Multimedia |volume=9 |issue=5 |pages=1062–1072 |doi=10.1109/TMM.2007.898943 |bibcode=2007ITMm....9.1062C |s2cid=870854 |issn=1520-9210}}</ref> The standard also includes a standard encryption mechanism<ref>{{cite web|url= https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-pantos-http-live-streaming-07|title= HTTP Live Streaming|last= Pantos|first= R.|date= 30 September 2011|publisher= Internet Engineering Task Force|access-date= 18 June 2013}}</ref> and secure-key distribution using [[HTTPS]], which together provide a simple [[Digital rights management|DRM]] system. Later versions of the protocol also provide for trick-mode fast-forward and rewind and for integration of subtitles.

Apple has documented HTTP Live Streaming as an [[Internet Draft]] (Individual Submission), the first stage in the process of publishing it as a [[Request for Comments]] (RFC). As of December 2015, the authors of that document have requested the RFC Independent Stream Editor (ISE) to publish the document as an informational (non-standard) RFC outside of the [[IETF]] consensus process.<ref>
